movies.description: Cobb, a skilled thief who commits corporate espionage by infiltrating the subconscious of his targets is offered a chance to regain his old life as payment for a task considered to be impossible: "inception", the implantation of another person's idea into a target's subconscious.

movies.title: Interstellar

details.tagline: Mankind was born on Earth. It was never meant to die here.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel and conquer the vast distances involved in an interstellar voyage.

movies.title: Whiplash

details.tagline: Do your best, he said…

movies.description: Under the direction of a ruthless instructor, a talented young drummer begins to pursue perfection at any cost, even his humanity.

movies.title: La La Land

details.tagline: Here's to the fools who dream.
details.writers: Damien Chazelle, Justin Paul, Benj Pasek

movies.description: Mia, an aspiring actress, serves lattes to movie stars in between auditions and Sebastian, a jazz musician, scrapes by playing cocktail party gigs in dingy bars, but as success mounts they are faced with decisions that begin to fray the fragile fabric of their love affair, and the dreams they worked so hard to maintain in each other threaten to rip them apart.

movies.title: Parasite

details.tagline: Act like you own the place.
details.writers: Kim Dae-hwan, Bong Joon Ho, Han Jin-won

movies.description: All unemployed, Ki-taek's family takes peculiar interest in the wealthy and glamorous Parks for their livelihood until they get entangled in an unexpected incident.

movies.title: Get Out

details.tagline: Just because you're invited, doesn't mean you're welcome.

movies.description: Chris and his girlfriend Rose go upstate to visit her parents for the weekend. At first, Chris reads the family's overly accommodating behavior as nervous attempts to deal with their daughter's interracial relationship, but as the weekend progresses, a series of increasingly disturbing discoveries lead him to a truth that he never could have imagined.

movies.title: Mad Max: Fury Road

details.tagline: The future belongs to the mad.
details.writers: George Miller, Nico Lathouris, Brendan McCarthy

movies.description: An apocalyptic story set in the furthest reaches of our planet, in a stark desert landscape where humanity is broken, and most everyone is crazed fighting for the necessities of life. Within this world exist two rebels on the run who just might be able to restore order.

movies.title: The Social Network

details.tagline: You don't get to 500 million friends without making a few enemies.

movies.description: In 2003, Harvard undergrad and computer programmer Mark Zuckerberg begins work on a new concept that eventually turns into the global social network known as Facebook. Six years later, Mark is one of the youngest billionaires ever, but his unprecedented success leads to both personal and legal complications when he ends up on the receiving end of two lawsuits, one involving his former friend.

movies.title: Gravity

details.tagline: Don't let go.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: Dr Ryan Stone, an engineer on her first space mission, and Matt Kowalski, an astronaut on his final expedition, have to survive in space after they are hit by debris while spacewalking.

movies.title: The Disappearance of Eleanor Rigby: Her

details.tagline: Two Films. One Love.

collection.name: The Disappearance Of Eleanor Rigby Collection

movies.description: Told from the woman's perspective, the story of a couple trying to reclaim the life and love they once knew and pick up the pieces of a past that may be too far gone.

movies.title: Django Unchained

details.tagline: Life, liberty, and the pursuit of vengeance.

movies.description: With the help of a German bounty hunter, a freed slave sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal Mississippi plantation owner.

movies.title: The Wolf of Wall Street

details.tagline: Earn. Spend. Party.

movies.description: A New York stockbroker refuses to cooperate in a large securities fraud case involving corruption on Wall Street, corporate banking world and mob infiltration. Based on Jordan Belfort's autobiography.

movies.title: 12 Years a Slave

details.tagline: The extraordinary true story of Solomon Northup.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: In the pre-Civil War United States, Solomon Northup, a free black man from upstate New York, is abducted and sold into slavery. Facing cruelty as well as unexpected kindnesses Solomon struggles not only to stay alive, but to retain his dignity. In the twelfth year of his unforgettable odyssey, Solomon’s chance meeting with a Canadian abolitionist will forever alter his life.

movies.title: Birdman
movies.description: A portrait of Robert, a troubled but poetic soul struggling with his purgatorial existence in a hackney scrapyard.

movies.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel

details.tagline: A murder case of Madam D. with enormous wealth and the most outrageous events surrounding her sudden death!
details.writers: Wes Anderson, Hugo Guinness, Stefan Zweig

movies.description: The Grand Budapest Hotel tells of a legendary concierge at a famous European hotel between the wars and his friendship with a young employee who becomes his trusted protégé. The story involves the theft and recovery of a priceless Renaissance painting, the battle for an enormous family fortune and the slow and then sudden upheavals that transformed Europe during the first half of the 20th century.

movies.title: Gone Girl

details.tagline: You don't know what you've got 'til it's...

movies.description: With his wife's disappearance having become the focus of an intense media circus, a man sees the spotlight turned on him when it's suspected that he may not be innocent.

movies.title: Shutter Island

details.tagline: Someone is missing.

movies.description: World War II soldier-turned-U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels investigates the disappearance of a patient from a hospital for the criminally insane, but his efforts are compromised by troubling visions and a mysterious doctor.

movies.title: The Avengers

details.tagline: Some assembly required.
details.writers: Joss Whedon, Zak Penn, Jack Kirby, Joe Simon

movies.description: When an unexpected enemy emerges and threatens global safety and security, Nick Fury, director of the international peacekeeping agency known as S.H.I.E.L.D., finds himself in need of a team to pull the world back from the brink of disaster. Spanning the globe, a daring recruitment effort begins!

movies.title: Guardians of the Galaxy

details.tagline: You're Welcome.
details.writers: Bill Mantlo, Keith Giffen, Jim Starlin, Steve Englehart

movies.description: Light years from Earth, 26 years after being abducted, Peter Quill finds himself the prime target of a manhunt after discovering an orb wanted by Ronan the Accuser.

movies.title: Avengers: Endgame

details.tagline: Avenge the fallen.
details.writers: Jim Starlin, Joe Simon, Jack Kirby, Steve Englehart

movies.description: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War, the universe is in ruins due to the efforts of the Mad Titan, Thanos. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers must assemble once more in order to undo Thanos' actions and restore order to the universe once and for all, no matter what consequences may be in store.

movies.title: Toy Story 3

details.tagline: No toy gets left behind.
details.writers: Nick Sung, Michael Arndt, John Lasseter, Lee Unkrich

movies.description: Woody, Buzz, and the rest of Andy's toys haven't been played with in years. With Andy about to go to college, the gang find themselves accidentally left at a nefarious day care center. The toys must band together to escape and return home to Andy.

movies.title: Inside Out

details.tagline: Meet the little voices inside your head.
details.writers: Meg LeFauve, Josh Cooley, Pete Docter, James S. Baker

movies.description: When 11-year-old Riley moves to a new city, her Emotions team up to help her through the transition. Joy, Fear, Anger, Disgust and Sadness work together, but when Joy and Sadness get lost, they must journey through unfamiliar places to get back home.

movies.title: Zootopia

details.tagline: Welcome to the urban jungle.
details.writers: Jared Bush, Phil Johnston, Byron Howard, Rich Moore

movies.description: Determined to prove herself, Officer Judy Hopps, the first bunny on Zootopia's police force, jumps at the chance to crack her first case - even if it means partnering with scam-artist fox Nick Wilde to solve the mystery.

movies.title: Coco

details.tagline: The celebration of a lifetime.
details.writers: Enrico Casarosa, Adrian Molina, Matthew Aldrich, Madeline Sharafian

movies.description: Despite his family’s baffling generations-old ban on music, Miguel dreams of becoming an accomplished musician like his idol, Ernesto de la Cruz. Desperate to prove his talent, Miguel finds himself in the stunning and colorful Land of the Dead following a mysterious chain of events. Along the way, he meets charming trickster Hector, and together, they set off on an extraordinary journey to unlock the real story behind Miguel's family history.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse

details.tagline: Enter a universe where more than one wears the mask.
details.writers: Phil Lord, Katie Smith, Kasey Fagerquist, Rodney Rothman

movies.description: Struggling to find his place in the world while juggling school and family, Brooklyn teenager Miles Morales is unexpectedly bitten by a radioactive spider and develops unfathomable powers just like the one and only Spider-Man. While wrestling with the implications of his new abilities, Miles discovers a super collider created by the madman Wilson "Kingpin" Fisk, causing others from across the Spider-Verse to be inadvertently transported to his dimension.

movies.title: John Wick

details.tagline: Don't set him off.

movies.description: Ex-hitman John Wick comes out of retirement to track down the gangsters that took everything from him.

movies.title: Sicario

details.tagline: The border is just another line to cross.

movies.description: An idealistic FBI agent is enlisted by a government task force to aid in the escalating war against drugs at the border area between the U.S. and Mexico.

movies.title: A Quiet Place

details.tagline: If they hear you, they hunt you.
details.writers: Bryan Woods, Scott Beck, John Krasinski

movies.description: A family is forced to live in silence while hiding from creatures that hunt by sound.

movies.title: Hereditary

details.tagline: Every family tree hides a secret.
details.country: United States of America, United Kingdom

movies.description: Following the death of the Leigh family matriarch, Annie and her children uncover disturbing secrets about their heritage. Their daily lives are not only impacted, but they also become entangled in a chilling fate from which they cannot escape, driving them to the brink of madness.

movies.title: It

details.tagline: You'll float too.
details.writers: Stephen King, Cary Joji Fukunaga, Chase Palmer, Gary Dauberman

movies.description: In a small town in Maine, seven children known as The Losers Club come face to face with life problems, bullies and a monster that takes the shape of a clown called Pennywise.

movies.title: The Conjuring

details.tagline: Based on the true case files of the Warrens.

movies.description: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren work to help a family terrorized by a dark presence in their farmhouse. Forced to confront a powerful entity, the Warrens find themselves caught in the most terrifying case of their lives.

movies.title: Knives Out

details.tagline: Hell, any of them could have done it.

movies.description: When renowned crime novelist Harlan Thrombey is found dead at his estate just after his 85th birthday, the inquisitive and debonair Detective Benoit Blanc is mysteriously enlisted to investigate. From Harlan's dysfunctional family to his devoted staff, Blanc sifts through a web of red herrings and self-serving lies to uncover the truth behind Harlan's untimely death.

movies.title: Crazy Rich Asians

details.tagline: The only thing crazier than love is family.
details.country: United States of America, Hong Kong
details.writers: Peter Chiarelli, Kevin Kwan, Adele Lim

movies.description: An American-born Chinese economics professor accompanies her boyfriend to Singapore for his best friend's wedding, only to get thrust into the lives of Asia's rich and famous.

movies.title: Silver Linings Playbook

details.tagline: Watch for the signs.

movies.description: After losing his job and wife, and spending time in an institution, a former teacher winds up living with his parents. He wants to rebuild his life and reconcile with his wife, but his father would be happy if he shared his obsession with the Philadelphia Eagles. Things get complicated when he meets Tiffany Maxwell who offers to help him reconnect with his wife if he will do something very important for her in exchange.

movies.title: The Fault in Our Stars

details.tagline: Life doesn't have to be perfect for love to be extraordinary.
details.writers: Scott Neustadter, Michael H. Weber, John Green

movies.description: Despite the tumor-shrinking medical miracle that has bought her a few years, Hazel has never been anything but terminal, her final chapter inscribed upon diagnosis. But when a patient named Augustus Waters suddenly appears at Cancer Kid Support Group, Hazel's story is about to be completely rewritten.

movies.title: Baby Driver

details.tagline: All you need is one killer track.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: After being coerced into working for a crime boss, a young getaway driver finds himself taking part in a heist doomed to fail.

movies.title: Logan

details.tagline: Someone has come along.
details.writers: Michael Green, Scott Frank, James Mangold

movies.description: In the near future, a weary Logan cares for an ailing Professor X in a hideout on the Mexican border. But Logan's attempts to hide from the world and his legacy are upended when a young mutant arrives, pursued by dark forces.

movies.title: Blade Runner 2049

details.tagline: The key to the future is finally unearthed.
details.language: English, Finnish, Hungarian, Japanese, Russian, Somali, Spanish
details.country: Canada, United Kingdom, United States of America
details.writers: Hampton Fancher, Michael Green, Philip K. Dick

movies.description: Thirty years after the events of the first film, a new blade runner, LAPD Officer K, unearths a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what's left of society into chaos. K's discovery leads him on a quest to find Rick Deckard, a former LAPD blade runner who has been missing for 30 years.

movies.title: Arrival

details.tagline: Why are they here?
details.writers: Ted Chiang, Eric Heisserer, Jessica Coon

movies.description: Taking place after alien crafts land around the world, an expert linguist is recruited by the military to determine whether they come in peace or are a threat.

movies.title: Dunkirk

details.tagline: When 400,000 men couldn't get home, home came for them.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: The story of the miraculous evacuation of Allied soldiers from Belgium, Britain, Canada and France, who were cut off and surrounded by the German army from the beaches and harbour of Dunkirk between May 26th and June 4th 1940 during World War II.

movies.title: Prisoners

details.tagline: How far would you go to protect your child?

movies.description: After his six-year-old daughter is abducted, a desperate father takes justice into his own hands when he loses faith in the detective leading the investigation, setting both men on a collision course as the search descends into obsession and moral compromise.

movies.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once

details.tagline: The universe is so much bigger than you realize.

movies.description: An aging Chinese immigrant is swept up in an insane adventure, where she alone can save what's important to her by connecting with the lives she could have led in other universes.

movies.title: Dune

details.tagline: It begins.
details.writers: Frank Herbert, Eric Roth, Denis Villeneuve, Jon Spaihts

movies.description: Paul Atreides, a brilliant and gifted young man born into a great destiny beyond his understanding, must travel to the most dangerous planet in the universe to ensure the future of his family and his people. As malevolent forces explode into conflict over the planet's exclusive supply of the most precious resource in existence - a commodity capable of unlocking humanity's greatest potential - only those who can conquer their fear will survive.

movies.title: Dune: Part Two

details.tagline: Long live the fighters.
details.writers: Denis Villeneuve, Jon Spaihts, Frank Herbert

movies.description: Follow the mythic journey of Paul Atreides as he unites with Chani and the Fremen while on a path of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the known universe, Paul endeavors to prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.

movies.title: Oppenheimer

details.tagline: The world forever changes.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
details.writers: Christopher Nolan, Kai Bird, Martin J. Sherwin

movies.description: The story of J. Robert Oppenheimer's role in the development of the atomic bomb during World War II.

movies.title: Top Gun: Maverick

details.tagline: Feel the need... The need for speed.
details.writers: Ehren Kruger, Eric Warren Singer, Christopher McQuarrie, Justin Marks

movies.description: After more than thirty years of service as one of the Navy’s top aviators, and dodging the advancement in rank that would ground him, Pete “Maverick” Mitchell finds himself training a detachment of TOP GUN graduates for a specialized mission the likes of which no living pilot has ever seen.

movies.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home

details.tagline: Enter the Multiverse.
details.writers: Steve Ditko, Stan Lee, Chris McKenna, Erik Sommers

movies.description: Peter Parker is unmasked and no longer able to separate his normal life from the high-stakes of being a super-hero. When he asks for help from Doctor Strange the stakes become even more dangerous, forcing him to discover what it truly means to be Spider-Man.

movies.title: The Batman

details.tagline: Unmask the truth.
details.writers: Peter Craig, Matt Reeves, Bob Kane, Bill Finger

movies.description: In his second year of fighting crime, Batman uncovers corruption in Gotham City that connects to his own family while facing a serial killer known as the Riddler.

movies.title: Nomadland

details.tagline: See you down the road.

movies.description: A woman in her sixties embarks on a journey through the western United States after losing everything in the Great Recession, living as a van-dwelling modern-day nomad.

movies.title: Soul

details.tagline: Everybody has a soul. Joe Gardner is about to find his.
details.writers: Kristen Lester, Aphton Corbin, Rosana Sullivan, Pete Docter

movies.description: Joe Gardner is a middle school teacher with a love for jazz music. After a successful audition at the Half Note Club, he suddenly gets into an accident that separates his soul from his body and is transported to the You Seminar, a center in which souls develop and gain passions before being transported to a newborn child. Joe must enlist help from the other souls-in-training, like 22, a soul who has spent eons in the You Seminar, in order to get back to Earth.

movies.title: Encanto

details.tagline: There's a little magic in all of us...almost all of us.
details.writers: Charise Castro Smith, Jared Bush, Jason Hand, Byron Howard

movies.description: The tale of an extraordinary family, the Madrigals, who live hidden in the mountains of Colombia, in a magical house, in a vibrant town, in a wondrous, charmed place called an Encanto. The magic of the Encanto has blessed every child in the family—every child except one, Mirabel. But when she discovers that the magic surrounding the Encanto is in danger, Mirabel decides that she, the only ordinary Madrigal, might just be her exceptional family's last hope.

movies.title: No Time to Die

details.tagline: The mission that changes everything begins…
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
details.writers: Ian Fleming, Cary Joji Fukunaga, Robert Wade, Neal Purvis

movies.description: Bond has left active service and is enjoying a tranquil life in Jamaica. His peace is short-lived when his old friend Felix Leiter from the CIA turns up asking for help. The mission to rescue a kidnapped scientist turns out to be far more treacherous than expected, leading Bond onto the trail of a mysterious villain armed with dangerous new technology.

movies.title: Tenet

details.tagline: Time runs out.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: Armed with only one word - Tenet - and fighting for the survival of the entire world, the Protagonist journeys through a twilight world of international espionage on a mission that will unfold in something beyond real time.

movies.title: Free Guy

details.tagline: Life's too short to be a background character.

movies.description: A bank teller discovers he is actually a background player in an open-world video game, and decides to become the hero of his own story. Now, in a world where there are no limits, he is determined to be the guy who saves his world his way before it's too late.

movies.title: The Menu

details.tagline: Painstakingly prepared. Brilliantly executed.

movies.description: A young couple travels to a remote island to eat at an exclusive restaurant where the chef has prepared a lavish menu, with some shocking surprises.

movies.title: Barbie

details.tagline: She's everything. He's just Ken.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: Barbie and Ken are having the time of their lives in the colorful and seemingly perfect world of Barbie Land. However, when they get a chance to go to the real world, they soon discover the joys and perils of living among humans.

movies.title: Poor Things

details.tagline: She’s nothing like you’ve ever seen.
details.country: Ireland, United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: Brought back to life by an unorthodox scientist, a young woman runs off with a lawyer on a whirlwind adventure across the continents. Free from the prejudices of her times, she grows steadfast in her purpose to stand for equality and liberation.

movies.title: Killers of the Flower Moon

details.tagline: Can you find the wolves in this picture?
details.writers: Martin Scorsese, Troy Caballero, David Grann, Eric Roth

movies.description: When oil is discovered in 1920s Oklahoma under Osage Nation land, the Osage people are murdered one by one—until the FBI steps in to unravel the mystery.

movies.title: Anatomy of a Fall

details.tagline: Did she do it?

movies.description: A woman is suspected of her husband's murder, and their blind son faces a moral dilemma as the sole witness.

movies.title: Past Lives

details.tagline: A heartrending modern romance that confronts notions of destiny, love, and the choices that make a life.
details.country: United States of America, South Korea

movies.description: After decades apart, childhood friends Nora and Hae Sung are reunited in New York for one fateful weekend as they confront notions of destiny, love, and the choices that make a life.

movies.title: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery

details.tagline: When the game ends, the mystery begins.

movies.description: World-famous detective Benoit Blanc heads to Greece to peel back the layers of a mystery surrounding a tech billionaire and his eclectic crew of friends.

movies.title: The Whale

details.tagline: I need to know that I have done one thing right with my life.

movies.description: A reclusive English teacher suffering from severe obesity attempts to reconnect with his estranged teenage daughter for one last chance at redemption.

movies.title: Nope

details.tagline: What’s a bad miracle?

movies.description: Residents in a lonely gulch of inland California bear witness to an uncanny, chilling discovery.

movies.title: X

details.tagline: Dying to show you a good time.

movies.description: In 1979, a group of young filmmakers set out to make an adult film in rural Texas, but when their reclusive, elderly hosts catch them in the act, the cast find themselves fighting for their lives.

movies.title: Pearl

details.tagline: An X-traordinary origin story.

movies.description: Trapped on her family’s isolated farm, Pearl must tend to her ailing father under the bitter and overbearing watch of her devout mother. Lusting for a glamorous life like she’s seen in the movies, Pearl’s ambitions, temptations, and repressions collide.

movies.title: The Northman

details.tagline: Conquer your fate.

movies.description: Prince Amleth is on the verge of becoming a man when his father is brutally murdered by his uncle, who kidnaps the boy's mother. Two decades later, Amleth is now a Viking who's on a mission to save his mother, kill his uncle and avenge his father.

movies.title: Turning Red

details.tagline: Growing up is a beast.
details.writers: Domee Shi, Julia Cho, Sarah Streicher, Rosana Sullivan

movies.description: Thirteen-year-old Mei is experiencing the awkwardness of being a teenager with a twist – when she gets too excited, she transforms into a giant red panda.

movies.title: Puss in Boots: The Last Wish

details.tagline: Say hola to his little friends.
details.writers: Tom Wheeler, Paul Fisher, Tommy Swerdlow, Heidi Jo Gilbert

movies.description: Puss in Boots discovers that his passion for adventure has taken its toll: He has burned through eight of his nine lives, leaving him with only one life left. Puss sets out on an epic journey to find the mythical Last Wish and restore his nine lives.

movies.title: The Fabelmans

details.tagline: Capture every moment.

movies.description: Growing up in post-World War II era Arizona, young Sammy Fabelman aspires to become a filmmaker as he reaches adolescence, but soon discovers a shattering family secret and explores how the power of films can help him see the truth.

movies.title: Licorice Pizza
movies.description: The story of Gary Valentine and Alana Kane growing up, running around and going through the treacherous navigation of first love in the San Fernando Valley, 1973.

movies.title: Challengers

details.tagline: Her game. Her rules.

movies.description: Tennis player turned coach Tashi has taken her husband, Art, and transformed him into a world-famous Major champion. To jolt him out of his recent losing streak, she signs him up for a "Challenger" event — close to the lowest level of pro tournament — where he finds himself standing across the net from his former best friend and Tashi's former boyfriend.

movies.title: Life Is Beautiful

details.tagline: An unforgettable fable that proves love, family and imagination conquer all.

movies.description: A touching story of an Italian book seller of Jewish ancestry who lives in his own little fairy tale. His creative and happy life would come to an abrupt halt when his entire family is deported to a concentration camp during World War II. While locked up he tries to convince his son that the whole thing is just a game.

movies.title: The Prestige

details.tagline: Are you watching closely?
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
details.writers: Christopher Nolan, Jonathan Nolan, Christopher Priest

movies.description: A mysterious story of two magicians whose intense rivalry leads them on a life-long battle for supremacy -- full of obsession, deceit and jealousy with dangerous and deadly consequences.

movies.title: Léon: The Professional

details.tagline: If you want the job done right, hire a professional.

movies.description: Léon, the top hit man in New York, has earned a rep as an effective "cleaner". But when his next-door neighbors are wiped out by a loose-cannon DEA agent, he becomes the unwilling custodian of 12-year-old Mathilda. Before long, Mathilda's thoughts turn to revenge, and she considers following in Léon's footsteps.

movies.title: American History X

details.tagline: Some legacies must end.

movies.description: Derek Vineyard is paroled after serving 3 years in prison for killing two African-American men. Through his brother, Danny Vineyard's narration, we learn that before going to prison, Derek was a skinhead and the leader of a violent white supremacist gang that committed acts of racial crime throughout L.A. and his actions greatly influenced Danny. Reformed and fresh out of prison, Derek severs contact with the gang and becomes determined to keep Danny from going down the same violent path as he did.

movies.title: The Intouchables

details.tagline: Sometimes you have to reach into someone else's world to find out what's missing in your own.
details.writers: Éric Toledano, Olivier Nakache, Philippe Pozzo di Borgo

movies.description: A true story of two men who should never have met – a quadriplegic aristocrat who was injured in a paragliding accident and a young man from the projects.

movies.title: The Pianist

details.tagline: Music was his passion. Survival was his masterpiece.

movies.description: The true story of pianist Władysław Szpilman's experiences in Warsaw during the Nazi occupation. When the Jews of the city find themselves forced into a ghetto, Szpilman finds work playing in a café; and when his family is deported in 1942, he stays behind, works for a while as a laborer, and eventually goes into hiding in the ruins of the war-torn city.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse

details.tagline: It's how you wear the mask that matters.
details.writers: David Callaham, Phil Lord, Christopher Miller, Kasey Fagerquist

movies.description: After reuniting with Gwen Stacy, Brooklyn’s full-time, friendly neighborhood Spider-Man is catapulted across the Multiverse, where he encounters the Spider Society, a team of Spider-People charged with protecting the Multiverse's very existence. But when the heroes clash on how to handle a new threat, Miles finds himself pitted against the other Spiders and must set out on his own to save those he loves most.

movies.title: Grave of the Fireflies

details.tagline: Why do fireflies have to die so soon?

castDetails.name: Masayo Sakai
castDetails.character: Woman who takes care of Setsuko (voice)

movies.description: In the final months of World War II, 14-year-old Seita and his sister Setsuko are orphaned when their mother is killed during an air raid in Kobe, Japan. After a falling out with their aunt, they move into an abandoned bomb shelter. With no surviving relatives and their emergency rations depleted, Seita and Setsuko struggle to survive.

movies.title: Cinema Paradiso

details.tagline: An enchanted village. A wonderful friendship. Star-crossed lovers. And the magic of the movies.

castDetails.name: Agnese Nano
castDetails.character: Elena Mendola (teen) / Elena's daughter (in Director's cut)

movies.description: A filmmaker recalls his childhood, when he fell in love with the movies at his village's theater and formed a deep friendship with the theater's projectionist.

movies.title: The Dark Knight Rises

details.tagline: The legend ends.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
details.writers: Christopher Nolan, David S. Goyer, Bob Kane, Jonathan Nolan

movies.description: Following the death of District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman assumes responsibility for Dent's crimes to protect the late attorney's reputation and is subsequently hunted by the Gotham City Police Department. Eight years later, Batman encounters the mysterious Selina Kyle and the villainous Bane, a new terrorist leader who overwhelms Gotham's finest. The Dark Knight resurfaces to protect a city that has branded him an enemy.

movies.title: Inglourious Basterds

details.tagline: Once upon a time in Nazi occupied France...

movies.description: In Nazi-occupied France during World War II, a group of Jewish-American soldiers known as "The Basterds" are chosen specifically to spread fear throughout the Third Reich by scalping and brutally killing Nazis. The Basterds, lead by Lt. Aldo Raine soon cross paths with a French-Jewish teenage girl who runs a movie theater in Paris which is targeted by the soldiers.

movies.title: Avengers: Infinity War

details.tagline: An entire universe. Once and for all.
details.writers: Joe Simon, Bill Mantlo, Jack Kirby, Steve Englehart

movies.description: As the Avengers and their allies have continued to protect the world from threats too large for any one hero to handle, a new danger has emerged from the cosmic shadows: Thanos. A despot of intergalactic infamy, his goal is to collect all six Infinity Stones, artifacts of unimaginable power, and use them to inflict his twisted will on all of reality. Everything the Avengers have fought for has led up to this moment - the fate of Earth and existence itself has never been more uncertain.

movies.title: 3 Idiots

details.tagline: Aal Izz Well!
details.writers: Rajkumar Hirani, Vir Chopra, Vidhu Vinod Chopra, Chetan Bhagat

movies.description: Rascal. Joker. Dreamer. Genius... You've never met a college student quite like "Rancho." From the moment he arrives at India's most prestigious university, Rancho's outlandish schemes turn the campus upside down—along with the lives of his two newfound best friends. Together, they make life miserable for "Virus," the school’s uptight and heartless dean. But when Rancho catches the eye of the dean's daughter, Virus sets his sights on flunking out the "3 idiots" once and for all.

movies.title: The Lives of Others

details.tagline: Before the Fall of the Berlin Wall, East Germany's Secret Police Listened to Your Secrets.

movies.description: In 1984 East Berlin, dedicated Stasi officer Gerd Wiesler begins spying on a famous playwright and his actress-lover Christa-Maria. Wiesler becomes unexpectedly sympathetic to the couple, and faces conflicting loyalties when his superior takes a liking to Christa-Maria.

movies.title: Joker

details.tagline: Put on a happy face.
details.writers: Scott Silver, Todd Phillips, Bill Finger, Bob Kane

movies.description: During the 1980s, a failed stand-up comedian is driven insane and turns to a life of crime and chaos in Gotham City while becoming an infamous psychopathic crime figure.

movies.title: Requiem for a Dream

details.tagline: A look into addiction and how it overcomes the mind and body.

movies.description: The drug-induced utopias of four Coney Island residents are shattered when their addictions run deep.

movies.title: Oldboy

details.tagline: 15 years of imprisonment, five days of vengeance.
details.writers: Im Joon-hyung, Hwang Jo-yoon, Park Chan-wook, Nobuaki Minegishi

movies.description: With no clue how he came to be imprisoned, drugged and tortured for 15 years, a desperate man seeks revenge on his captors.

movies.title: Princess Mononoke

details.tagline: The fate of the world rests on the courage of one warrior.

movies.description: Ashitaka, a prince of the disappearing Emishi people, is cursed by a demonized boar god and must journey to the west to find a cure. Along the way, he encounters San, a young human woman fighting to protect the forest, and Lady Eboshi, who is trying to destroy it. Ashitaka must find a way to bring balance to this conflict.

movies.title: The Hunt

details.tagline: The lie is spreading.

movies.description: A teacher lives a lonely life, all the while struggling over his son’s custody. His life slowly gets better as he finds love and receives good news from his son, but his new luck is about to be brutally shattered by an innocent little lie.

movies.title: Once Upon a Time in America

details.tagline: Crime, passion and lust for power.
details.writers: Sergio Leone, Enrico Medioli, Piero De Bernardi, Franco Arcalli

movies.description: A former Prohibition-era Jewish gangster returns to the Lower East Side of Manhattan over thirty years later, where he once again must confront the ghosts and regrets of his old life.

movies.title: Capernaum

details.tagline: It takes courage to hope.
details.country: France, Lebanon, United Kingdom, United States of America
details.writers: Nadine Labaki, Jihad Hojeily, Georges Khabbaz, Michelle Keserwany

movies.description: After running away from his negligent parents, committing a violent crime and being sentenced to five years in jail, a hardened, streetwise 12-year-old Lebanese boy sues his parents in protest of the life they have given him.

movies.title: Das Boot

details.tagline: On land they dreamed of being heroes. Beneath the sea they pray to be survivors.
details.writers: Lothar-Günther Buchheim, Wolfgang Petersen, Dean Riesner

movies.description: A German submarine hunts allied ships during the Second World War, but it soon becomes the hunted. The crew tries to survive below the surface, while stretching both the boat and themselves to their limits.

movies.title: A Separation

details.tagline: Ugly truth, sweet lies.

movies.description: A married couple are faced with a difficult decision – to improve the life of their child by moving to another country or to stay in Iran and look after a deteriorating parent who has Alzheimer's disease.

movies.title: Incendies

details.tagline: 2 letters. One for the brother. One for the father.
details.writers: Wajdi Mouawad, Valérie Beaugrand-Champagne, Denis Villeneuve

movies.description: A mother's last wishes send twins Jeanne and Simon on a journey to Middle East in search of their tangled roots. Adapted from Wajdi Mouawad's acclaimed play, Incendies tells the powerful and moving tale of two young adults' voyage to the core of deep-rooted hatred, never-ending wars and enduring love.

movies.title: Dangal

details.writers: Shreyas Jain, Piyush Gupta, Nitesh Tiwari, Nikhil Mehrotra

movies.description: Dangal is an extraordinary true story based on the life of Mahavir Singh and his two daughters, Geeta and Babita Phogat. The film traces the inspirational journey of a father who trains his daughters to become world class wrestlers.

movies.title: Like Stars on Earth

details.tagline: Every child is special.

movies.description: Ishaan Awasthi is an eight-year-old whose world is filled with wonders that no one else seems to appreciate. Colours, fish, dogs, and kites don't seem important to the adults, who are much more interested in things like homework, marks, and neatness. Ishaan cannot seem to get anything right in class; he is then sent to boarding school, where his life changes forever.

movies.title: A Beautiful Mind

details.tagline: He saw the world in a way no one could have imagined.
details.writers: Akiva Goldsman, Sylvia Nasar, Will Jennings

movies.description: From the heights of notoriety to the depths of depravity, John Forbes Nash Jr. experiences it all. As a brilliant but socially awkward mathematician, he made a groundbreaking discovery early in his career and stands on the brink of international acclaim. But as the handsome and arrogant Nash accepts secret work in cryptography, he becomes entangled in a mysterious conspiracy. His life takes a nightmarish turn and he soon finds himself on a painful and harrowing journey of self-discovery.

movies.title: Snatch

details.tagline: Stealin' stones and breakin' bones.

movies.description: Unscrupulous boxing promoters, violent bookies, a Russian gangster, incompetent amateur robbers, and supposedly Jewish jewellers fight to track down a priceless stolen diamond.

movies.title: Green Book

details.tagline: Inspired by a True Friendship.
details.writers: Nick Vallelonga, Brian Hayes Currie, Peter Farrelly

movies.description: Tony Lip, a bouncer in 1962, is hired to drive pianist Don Shirley on a tour through the Deep South in the days when African Americans, forced to find alternate accommodations and services due to segregation laws below the Mason-Dixon Line, relied on a guide called The Negro Motorist Green Book.

movies.title: Casino

details.tagline: No one stays at the top forever.

movies.description: In Las Vegas, two best friends--a casino executive and a Mafia enforcer--compete for a gambling empire and a fast-living, fast-loving socialite.

movies.title: The Thing

details.tagline: Anytime. Anywhere. Anyone.
details.writers: Bill Lancaster, John W. Campbell Jr.

movies.description: A research team in Antarctica is hunted by a shape-shifting alien that assumes the appearance of its victims.

movies.title: Howl's Moving Castle

details.tagline: Love comes first.

movies.description: Sophie, a young milliner, is turned into an elderly woman by a witch who enters her shop and curses her. She encounters a wizard named Howl and gets caught up in his resistance to fighting for the king.

movies.title: Unforgiven

details.tagline: Some legends will never be forgotten. Some wrongs can never be forgiven.

movies.description: William Munny is a retired, once-ruthless killer turned gentle widower and hog farmer. To help support his two motherless children, he accepts one last bounty-hunter mission to find the men who brutalized a prostitute. Joined by his former partner and a cocky greenhorn, he takes on a corrupt sheriff.

movies.title: Downfall

details.tagline: April 1945, a nation awaits its... Downfall
details.writers: Joachim Fest, Bernd Eichinger, Traudl Junge, Melissa Müller

movies.description: In April of 1945, Germany stands at the brink of defeat with the Russian Army closing in from the east and the Allied Expeditionary Force attacking from the west. In Berlin, capital of the Third Reich, Adolf Hitler proclaims that Germany will still achieve victory and orders his generals and advisers to fight to the last man. When the end finally does come, and Hitler lies dead by his own hand, what is left of his military must find a way to end the killing that is the Battle of Berlin, and lay down their arms in surrender.

movies.title: The Elephant Man

details.tagline: A true story of courage and human dignity.
details.country: United States of America, United Kingdom
details.writers: David Lynch, Christopher De Vore, Eric Bergren, Ashley Montagu

movies.description: A Victorian surgeon rescues a heavily disfigured man being mistreated by his "owner" as a side-show freak. Behind his monstrous façade, there is revealed a person of great intelligence and sensitivity.

movies.title: The Great Escape

details.tagline: Put a fence in front of these men... and they'll climb it!
details.writers: James Clavell, Paul Brickhill, W.R. Burnett

movies.description: The Nazis, exasperated at the number of escapes from their prison camps by a relatively small number of Allied prisoners, relocate them to a high-security 'escape-proof' camp to sit out the remainder of the war. Undaunted, the prisoners plan one of the most ambitious escape attempts of World War II. Based on a true story.

movies.title: The Secret in Their Eyes

details.tagline: An unsolved crime. A love story. An unwritten ending.

movies.description: Hoping to put to rest years of unease concerning a past case, retired criminal investigator Benjamín begins writing a novel based on the unsolved mystery of a newlywed’s rape and murder. With the help of a former colleague, judge Irene, he attempts to make sense of the past.

movies.title: Klaus

details.tagline: A true selfless act always sparks another.
details.writers: Zach Lewis, Jim Mahoney, Sergio Pablos, Edgar Martins

movies.description: A selfish postman and a reclusive toymaker form an unlikely friendship, delivering joy to a cold, dark town that desperately needs it.

movies.title: Bicycle Thieves

details.tagline: The Prize Picture They Want to Censor!
details.writers: Vittorio De Sica, Gerardo Guerrieri, Oreste Biancoli, Suso Cecchi d'Amico

movies.description: Unemployed Antonio is elated when he finally finds work hanging posters around war-torn Rome. However on his first day, his bicycle—essential to his work—gets stolen. His job is doomed unless he can find the thief. With the help of his son, Antonio combs the city, becoming desperate for justice.

movies.title: Ran

details.tagline: In a mad world, only the mad are sane.
details.writers: Akira Kurosawa, Hideo Oguni, William Shakespeare, Masato Ide

movies.description: Shakespeare's King Lear is reimagined as a singular historical epic set in sixteenth-century Japan where an aging warlord divides his kingdom between his three sons.

movies.title: Yojimbo

details.tagline: Kill one or a hundred... you only hang once

movies.description: A nameless ronin, or samurai with no master, enters a small village in feudal Japan where two rival businessmen are struggling for control of the local gambling trade. Taking the name Sanjuro Kuwabatake, the ronin convinces both silk merchant Tazaemon and sake merchant Tokuemon to hire him as a personal bodyguard, then artfully sets in motion a full-scale gang war between the two ambitious and unscrupulous men.

movies.title: Catch Me If You Can

details.tagline: The true story of a real fake.
details.writers: Jeff Nathanson, Stan Redding, Frank Abagnale Jr.

movies.description: A true story about Frank Abagnale Jr. who, before his 19th birthday, successfully conned millions of dollars worth of checks as a Pan Am pilot, doctor, and legal prosecutor. An FBI agent makes it his mission to put him behind bars. But Frank not only eludes capture, he revels in the pursuit.

movies.title: V for Vendetta

details.tagline: People should not be afraid of their governments. Governments should be afraid of their people.
details.country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
details.writers: Lilly Wachowski, Lana Wachowski, Harvey Price

movies.description: In a world in which Great Britain has become a fascist state, a masked vigilante known only as “V” conducts guerrilla warfare against the oppressive British government. When V rescues a young woman from the secret police, he finds in her an ally with whom he can continue his fight to free the people of Britain.

movies.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2

details.tagline: It all ends.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: Harry, Ron and Hermione continue their quest to vanquish the evil Voldemort once and for all. Just as things begin to look hopeless for the young wizards, Harry discovers a trio of magical objects that endow him with powers to rival Voldemort's formidable skills.

movies.title: Ratatouille

details.tagline: He's dying to become a chef.
details.writers: Jan Pinkava, Jim Capobianco, Brad Bird, Josh Cooley

movies.description: In one of Paris's finest restaurants, Remy, a determined young rat, dreams of becoming a renowned French chef. Torn between his family's wishes and his true calling, Remy and his pal Linguini set in motion a hilarious chain of events that turns the City of Lights upside down.

movies.title: The Big Lebowski

details.tagline: Times like these call for a Big Lebowski.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: Jeffrey 'The Dude' Lebowski, a Los Angeles slacker who only wants to bowl and drink White Russians, is mistaken for another Jeffrey Lebowski, a wheelchair-bound millionaire, and finds himself dragged into a strange series of events involving nihilists, adult film producers, ferrets, errant toes, and large sums of money.

movies.title: How to Train Your Dragon

details.tagline: What started as fire and fury will become friendship.

collection.name: How to Train Your Dragon Collection

details.writers: Dean DeBlois, Chris Sanders, Stephan Franck, William Davies

movies.description: As the son of a Viking leader on the cusp of manhood, shy Hiccup Horrendous Haddock III faces a rite of passage: he must kill a dragon to prove his warrior mettle. But after downing a feared dragon, he realizes that he no longer wants to destroy it, and instead befriends the beast – which he names Toothless – much to the chagrin of his warrior father.

movies.title: Gran Torino

details.tagline: Get off my lawn.

movies.description: Disgruntled Korean War veteran Walt Kowalski sets out to reform his neighbor, Thao Lor, a Hmong teenager who tried to steal Kowalski's prized possession: a 1972 Gran Torino.

movies.title: Fargo

details.tagline: A lot can happen in the middle of nowhere.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: Jerry Lundegaard is a small-town Minnesota car salesman deeply in debt and willing to do almost anything to get out. Police chief Marge Gunderson discovers a string of violent crimes as Jerry's schemes spiral out of control.

movies.title: Million Dollar Baby

details.tagline: Beyond his silence, there is a past. Beyond her dreams, there is a feeling. Beyond hope, there is a memory. Beyond their journey, there is a love.

movies.description: Despondent over a painful estrangement from his daughter, trainer Frankie Dunn isn't prepared for boxer Maggie Fitzgerald to enter his life. But Maggie's determined to go pro and to convince Dunn and his cohort to help her.

movies.title: Hacksaw Ridge

details.tagline: One of the greatest heroes in American history never fired a bullet.
details.country: Australia, United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: WWII American Army Medic Desmond T. Doss, who served during the Battle of Okinawa, refuses to kill people and becomes the first Conscientious Objector in American history to receive the Congressional Medal of Honor.

movies.title: Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels

details.tagline: A Disgrace to Criminals Everywhere.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: A card shark and his unwillingly-enlisted friends need to make a lot of cash quick after losing a sketchy poker match. To do this they decide to pull a heist on a small-time gang who happen to be operating out of the flat next door.

movies.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri

details.tagline: A mother personally challenges the local authorities to solve her daughter's murder when they fail to catch the culprit.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: After seven months have passed without a culprit in her daughter's murder case, Mildred Hayes makes a bold move, painting three signs leading into her town with a controversial message directed at Bill Willoughby, the town's revered chief of police. When his second-in-command Officer Jason Dixon, an immature mother's boy with a penchant for violence, gets involved, the battle between Mildred and Ebbing's law enforcement is only exacerbated.

movies.title: Ford v Ferrari

details.tagline: They took the American dream for a ride.
details.writers: John-Henry Butterworth, Jez Butterworth, Jason Keller, Ron Peters

movies.description: American car designer Carroll Shelby and the British-born driver Ken Miles work together to battle corporate interference, the laws of physics, and their own personal demons to build a revolutionary race car for Ford Motor Company and take on the dominating race cars of Enzo Ferrari at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in France in 1966.

movies.title: Rush

details.tagline: Everyone's driven by something.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: In the 1970s, a rivalry propels race car drivers Niki Lauda and James Hunt to fame and glory — until a horrible accident threatens to end it all.

movies.title: Spotlight

details.tagline: Break the story. Break the silence.

movies.description: The true story of how the Boston Globe uncovered the massive scandal of child molestation and cover-up within the local Catholic Archdiocese, shaking the entire Catholic Church to its core.

movies.title: Warrior

details.tagline: Family is worth fighting for.
details.writers: Gavin O'Connor, Anthony Tambakis, Cliff Dorfman

movies.description: The youngest son of an alcoholic former boxer returns home, where he's trained by his father for competition in a mixed martial arts tournament – a path that puts the fighter on a collision course with his estranged, older brother.

movies.title: The Help

details.tagline: Change begins with a whisper.
details.writers: Tate Taylor, Kathryn Stockett, Damon Thomas

movies.description: Aibileen Clark is a middle-aged African-American maid who has spent her life raising white children and has recently lost her only son; Minny Jackson is an African-American maid who has often offended her employers despite her family's struggles with money and her desperate need for jobs; and Eugenia "Skeeter" Phelan is a young white woman who has recently moved back home after graduating college to find out her childhood maid has mysteriously disappeared. These three stories intertwine to explain how life in Jackson, Mississippi revolves around "the help"; yet they are always kept at a certain distance because of racial lines.

movies.title: Room

details.tagline: Love knows no boundaries.
details.country: Canada, Ireland, United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: Held captive for 7 years in an enclosed space, a woman and her young son finally gain their freedom, allowing the boy to experience the outside world for the first time.

movies.title: My Neighbor Totoro

details.tagline: He's your friendly neighbourhood forest spirit!

movies.description: Two sisters move to the country with their father in order to be closer to their hospitalized mother, and discover the surrounding trees are inhabited by Totoros, magical spirits of the forest. When the youngest runs away from home, the older sister seeks help from the spirits to find her.

movies.title: Hotel Rwanda

details.tagline: When the world closed its eyes, he opened his arms.
details.country: United States of America, United Kingdom, Italy, South Africa

movies.description: Inspired by true events, this film takes place in Rwanda in the 1990s when more than a million Tutsis were killed in a genocide that went mostly unnoticed by the rest of the world. Hotel owner Paul Rusesabagina houses over a thousand refuges in his hotel in attempt to save their lives.

movies.title: Before Sunrise

details.tagline: Can the greatest romance of your life last only one night?

movies.description: An unexpected meeting on a train leads two travelers to spend an evening wandering through Vienna. As the night unfolds, they share stories and conversations about life and love, exploring new ideas while a quiet intimacy grows between them, knowing it may be their only night together.

movies.title: Before Sunset

details.tagline: What if you had a second chance with the one that got away?
details.writers: Richard Linklater, Julie Delpy, Ethan Hawke, Kim Krizan

movies.description: Nine years later, Jesse travels across Europe giving readings from a book he wrote about the night he spent in Vienna with Celine. After his reading in Paris, Celine finds him, and they spend part of the day together before Jesse has to again leave for a flight. They are both in relationships now, and Jesse has a son, but as their strong feelings for each other start to return, both confess a longing for more.

movies.title: The Sound of Music

details.tagline: The happiest sound in all the world!
details.writers: Ernest Lehman, Howard Lindsay, Russel Crouse, Richard Rodgers

movies.description: In the years before World War II, a tomboyish postulant at an Austrian abbey is hired as a governess in the home of a widowed naval captain with seven children and brings a new love of life and music into the home.

movies.title: Memories of Murder

details.tagline: The worst of them will stay with you... forever.
details.writers: Bong Joon Ho, Kim Gwang-rim, Shim Sung-bo

movies.description: A sadistic serial rapist and murderer of young women terrorizes a small province in 1980s South Korea. To prevent further crimes, three increasingly desperate detectives with conflicting methods race against time to unravel the violent mind of the killer in a futile effort to solve the case.

movies.title: The Iron Giant

details.tagline: It came from outer space!
details.writers: Tim McCanlies, Jeffrey Lynch, Brad Bird, Ted Hughes

movies.description: In the small town of Rockwell, Maine in October 1957, a giant metal machine befriends a nine-year-old boy and ultimately finds its humanity by unselfishly saving people from their own fears and prejudices.

movies.title: Wild Tales

details.tagline: We can all lose control

castDetails.name: Érica Rivas
castDetails.character: Romina (segment "Hasta que la muerte nos separe")

movies.description: Injustice and the demands of the world can cause stress for many people. Some of them, however, explode. This includes a waitress serving a grouchy loan shark, an altercation between two motorists, an ill-fated wedding reception, and a wealthy businessman who tries to buy his family out of trouble.

movies.title: The Wild Robot

details.tagline: Discover your true nature.
details.writers: Chris Sanders, Heidi Jo Gilbert, Adam Rosette, Peter Brown

movies.description: After a shipwreck, an intelligent robot called Roz is stranded on an uninhabited island. To survive the harsh environment, Roz bonds with the island's animals and cares for an orphaned baby goose.

movies.title: La Haine

details.tagline: How far you fall doesn't matter, it's how you land…

movies.description: After a chaotic night of rioting in a marginal suburb of Paris, three young friends, Vinz, Hubert and Saïd, wander around unoccupied waiting for news about the state of health of a mutual friend who has been seriously injured when confronting the police.

movies.title: The Seventh Seal

details.tagline: The story of a challenge to death.

movies.description: When disillusioned Swedish knight Antonius Block returns home from the Crusades to find his country in the grips of the Black Death, he challenges Death to a chess match for his life. Tormented by the belief that God does not exist, Block sets off on a journey, meeting up with traveling players Jof and his wife, Mia, and becoming determined to evade Death long enough to commit one redemptive act while he still lives.

movies.title: The Handmaiden

details.tagline: You're the one being tricked.
details.writers: Park Chan-wook, Jeong Seo-kyeong, Sarah Waters

movies.description: 1930s Korea, in the period of Japanese occupation, a new girl, Sook-hee, is hired as a handmaiden to a Japanese heiress, Hideko, who lives a secluded life on a large countryside estate with her domineering Uncle Kouzuki. But the maid has a secret. She is a pickpocket recruited by a swindler posing as a Japanese Count to help him seduce the Lady to steal her fortune.

movies.title: Barry Lyndon

details.tagline: Upstart. Soldier. Hero. Deserter. Scoundrel.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: An Irish rogue uses his cunning and wit to work his way up the social classes of 18th century England, transforming himself from the humble Redmond Barry into the noble Barry Lyndon.

movies.title: In the Name of the Father

details.tagline: In the name of truth... In the name of justice... In the name of love.
details.writers: Jim Sheridan, Terry George, Gerry Conlon

movies.description: A small-time Belfast thief, Gerry Conlon, is wrongly convicted of an IRA bombing in London, along with his father and friends, and spends 15 years in prison fighting to prove his innocence.

movies.title: Rashomon

details.tagline: The husband, the wife… or the bandit?
details.writers: Ryūnosuke Akutagawa, Akira Kurosawa, Shinobu Hashimoto

movies.description: Four people recount different versions of the story of a man's murder and the rape of his wife.

movies.title: Paris, Texas

details.tagline: A place for dreams. A place for heartbreak. A place to pick up the pieces.
details.writers: Sam Shepard, Walter Donohue, L.M. Kit Carson

movies.description: A man wanders out of the desert not knowing who he is. His brother finds him, and helps to pull his memory back of the life he led before he walked out on his family and disappeared four years earlier.

movies.title: Lagaan: Once Upon a Time in India

details.tagline: Once upon a time in India
details.writers: Ashutosh Gowariker, Sanjay Dayma, Kumar Dave, K.P. Saxena

movies.description: The year is 1893 and India is under British occupation. In a small village, the tyrannical Captain Russell has imposed an unprecedented land tax on its citizens. Outraged, Bhuvan, a rebellious farmer, rallies the villagers to publicly oppose the tax. Russell offers a novel way to settle the dispute: he challenges Bhuvan and his men to a game of cricket, a sport completely foreign to India. If Bhuvan and his men can defeat Russell's team, the tax will be repealed.

movies.title: Deadpool

details.tagline: Feel the love.
details.writers: Rhett Reese, Paul Wernick, Rob Liefeld, Fabian Nicieza

movies.description: The origin story of former Special Forces operative turned mercenary Wade Wilson, who, after being subjected to a rogue experiment that leaves him with accelerated healing powers, adopts the alter ego Deadpool. Armed with his new abilities and a dark, twisted sense of humor, Deadpool hunts down the man who nearly destroyed his life.

movies.title: The Martian

details.tagline: Bring him home.
details.writers: Andy Weir, Drew Goddard, Chris Katinas

movies.description: During a manned mission to Mars, Astronaut Mark Watney is presumed dead after a fierce storm and left behind by his crew. But Watney has survived and finds himself stranded and alone on the hostile planet. With only meager supplies, he must draw upon his ingenuity, wit and spirit to subsist and find a way to signal to Earth that he is alive.

movies.title: The Revenant

details.tagline: Blood lost. Life found.
details.country: Canada, Hong Kong, Taiwan, United States of America
details.writers: Michael Punke, Alejandro G. Iñárritu, Mark L. Smith

movies.description: In the 1820s, a frontiersman, Hugh Glass, sets out on a path of vengeance against those who left him for dead after a bear mauling.

movies.title: Black Swan

details.tagline: Perfection is not what it seems.
details.writers: Mark Heyman, Andres Heinz, John J. McLaughlin

movies.description: A committed dancer struggles to maintain her sanity after winning the lead role in a production of Tchaikovsky's "Swan Lake."

movies.title: The Imitation Game

details.tagline: The true enigma was the man who cracked the code.
details.country: United States of America, United Kingdom

movies.description: Based on the real life story of legendary cryptanalyst Alan Turing, the film portrays the nail-biting race against time by Turing and his brilliant team of code-breakers at Britain's top-secret Government Code and Cypher School at Bletchley Park, during the darkest days of World War II.

movies.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 2

details.tagline: The bride is back for the final cut.

castDetails.name: Uma Thurman
castDetails.character: Beatrix Kiddo / The Bride / 'Black Mamba' / Mommy

movies.description: The Bride unwaveringly continues on her roaring rampage of revenge against the band of assassins who had tried to kill her and her unborn child. She visits each of her former associates one-by-one, checking off the victims on her Death List Five until there's nothing left to do … but kill Bill.

movies.title: Sin City

details.tagline: There is no justice without sin.

movies.description: Welcome to Sin City. This town beckons to the tough, the corrupt, the brokenhearted. Some call it dark… Hard-boiled. Then there are those who call it home — Crooked cops, sexy dames, desperate vigilantes. Some are seeking revenge, others lust after redemption, and then there are those hoping for a little of both. A universe of unlikely and reluctant heroes still trying to do the right thing in a city that refuses to care.

movies.title: Casino Royale

details.tagline: Everyone has a past. Every legend has a beginning.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
details.writers: Robert Wade, Neal Purvis, Paul Haggis, Ian Fleming

movies.description: Le Chiffre, a banker to the world's terrorists, is scheduled to participate in a high-stakes poker game in Montenegro, where he intends to use his winnings to establish his financial grip on the terrorist market. M sends Bond—on his maiden mission as a 00 Agent—to attend this game and prevent Le Chiffre from winning. With the help of Vesper Lynd and Felix Leiter, Bond enters the most important poker game in his already dangerous career.

movies.title: The King's Speech

details.tagline: Find your voice.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: The King's Speech tells the story of the man who became King George VI, the father of Queen Elizabeth II. After his brother abdicates, George ('Bertie') reluctantly assumes the throne. Plagued by a dreaded stutter and considered unfit to be king, Bertie engages the help of an unorthodox speech therapist named Lionel Logue. Through a set of unexpected techniques, and as a result of an unlikely friendship, Bertie is able to find his voice and boldly lead the country into war.

movies.title: Into the Wild

details.tagline: Into the heart. Into the soul.

movies.description: After graduating from Emory University in 1992, top student and athlete Christopher McCandless abandons his possessions, gives his entire $24,000 savings account to charity, and hitchhikes to Alaska to live in the wilderness.

movies.title: The Bourne Ultimatum

details.tagline: Remember everything. Forgive nothing.
details.country: United States of America, United Kingdom
details.writers: George Nolfi, Scott Z. Burns, Tony Gilroy, Robert Ludlum

movies.description: Bourne is brought out of hiding once again by reporter Simon Ross who is trying to unveil Operation Blackbriar, an upgrade to Project Treadstone, in a series of newspaper columns. Information from the reporter stirs a new set of memories, and Bourne must finally uncover his dark past while dodging The Company's best efforts to eradicate him.

movies.title: Twelve Monkeys

details.tagline: The future is history.
details.writers: David Webb Peoples, Janet Peoples, Chris Marker

movies.description: In the year 2035, convict James Cole reluctantly volunteers to be sent back in time to discover the origin of a deadly virus that wiped out nearly all of the earth's population and forced the survivors into underground communities. But when Cole is mistakenly sent to 1990 instead of 1996, he's arrested and locked up in a mental hospital. There he meets psychiatrist Dr. Kathryn Railly and the son of a famous virus expert who may hold the key to the Army of the 12 Monkeys; thought to be responsible for unleashing the killer disease.

movies.title: The Pursuit of Happyness

details.tagline: For his son, one man will reach for the impossible.

movies.description: A struggling salesman takes custody of his son as he's poised to begin a life-changing professional career.

movies.title: Blood Diamond

details.tagline: It will cost you everything.

movies.description: An ex-mercenary turned smuggler. A Mende fisherman. Amid the explosive civil war overtaking 1999 Sierra Leone, these men join for two desperate missions: recovering a rare pink diamond of immense value and rescuing the fisherman's son, conscripted as a child soldier into the brutal rebel forces ripping a swath of torture and bloodshed countrywide.

movies.title: Rain Man

details.tagline: A journey through understanding and fellowship.

movies.description: When car dealer Charlie Babbitt learns that his estranged father has died, he returns home to Cincinnati, where he discovers that he has a savant older brother named Raymond and that his father's $3 million fortune is being left to the mental institution in which Raymond lives. Motivated by his father's money, Charlie checks Raymond out of the facility in order to return with him to Los Angeles. The brothers' cross-country trip ends up changing both their lives.

movies.title: Beauty and the Beast

details.tagline: The most beautiful love story ever told.
details.writers: Chris Sanders, Brenda Chapman, Robert Lence, Bruce Woodside

movies.description: Follow the adventures of Belle, a bright young woman who finds herself in the castle of a prince who's been turned into a mysterious beast. With the help of the castle's enchanted staff, Belle soon learns the most important lesson of all -- that true beauty comes from within.

movies.title: Aladdin

details.tagline: Imagine if you had three wishes, three hopes, three dreams and they all could come true.
details.writers: Ron Clements, Ted Elliott, Terry Rossio, John Musker

movies.description: In the boorish city of Agrabah, kind-hearted street urchin Aladdin and Princess Jasmine fall in love, although she can only marry a prince. He and power-hungry Grand Vizier Jafar vie for a magic lamp that can fulfill their wishes.

movies.title: Life of Brian

details.tagline: He's not the messiah...he's just a naughty boy.
details.writers: Graham Chapman, John Cleese, Terry Gilliam, Eric Idle

castDetails.name: Graham Chapman
castDetails.character: Wise Man #2 / Brian Cohen / Biggus Dickus

castDetails.name: John Cleese
castDetails.character: Wise Man #1 / Reg / Jewish Official / First Centurion / Deadly Dirk / Arthur

castDetails.name: Terry Gilliam
castDetails.character: Man Even Further Forward / Revolutionary / Jailer / Blood and Thunder Prophet / Frank / Audience Member / Crucifee

castDetails.name: Eric Idle
castDetails.character: Mr. Cheeky / Stan 'Loretta' / Harry the Haggler / Culprit Woman / Warris / Intensely Dull Youth / Jailer's Assistant / Otto / Lead Singer Crucifee

castDetails.name: Terry Jones
castDetails.character: Mandy Cohen / Colin / Simon the Holy Man / Bob Hoskins / Saintly Passer-by / Alarmed Crucifixion Assistant

castDetails.name: Michael Palin
castDetails.character: Wise Man #3 / Mr. Big Nose / Francis / Mrs. A / Ex-Leper / Announcer / Ben / Pontius Pilate / Boring Prophet / Eddie / Shoe Follower / Nisus Wettus

castDetails.name: Charles McKeown
castDetails.character: False Prophet / Blind Man / Giggling Guard / Stig

castDetails.name: John Young
castDetails.character: Matthias, Son of Deuteronomy of Gath

movies.description: Brian Cohen is an average young Jewish man, but through a series of ridiculous events, he gains a reputation as the Messiah. When he's not dodging his followers or being scolded by his shrill mother, the hapless Brian has to contend with the pompous Pontius Pilate and acronym-obsessed members of a separatist movement. Rife with Monty Python's signature absurdity, the tale finds Brian's life paralleling Biblical lore, albeit with many more laughs.

movies.title: Magnolia

details.tagline: Things fall down. People look up. And when it rains, it pours.

movies.description: On one random day in the San Fernando Valley, a dying father, a young wife, a male caretaker, a famous lost son, a police officer in love, a boy genius, an ex-boy genius, a game show host and an estranged daughter will each become part of a dazzling multiplicity of plots, but one story.

movies.title: Dances with Wolves

details.tagline: Inside everyone is a frontier waiting to be discovered.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: Wounded Civil War soldier John Dunbar tries to commit suicide—and becomes a hero instead. As a reward, he's assigned to his dream post, a remote junction on the Western frontier, and soon makes unlikely friends with the local Sioux tribe.

movies.title: Amores Perros

details.tagline: Love. Betrayal. Death.

movies.description: A fatalistic car crash in Mexico city sets off a chain of events in the lives of three people: a supermodel, a young man wanting to run off with his sister-in-law, and a homeless man.

movies.title: Gandhi

details.tagline: His triumph changed the world forever.

movies.description: In the early years of the 20th century, Mohandas K. Gandhi, a British-trained lawyer, forsakes all worldly possessions to take up the cause of Indian independence. Faced with armed resistance from the British government, Gandhi adopts a policy of 'passive resistance', endeavouring to win freedom for his people without resorting to bloodshed.

movies.title: CODA

details.tagline: Every family has its own language.
details.writers: Sian Heder, Victoria Bedos, Stanislas Carré de Malberg, Éric Lartigau

movies.description: As a CODA (Child of Deaf Adults), Ruby is the only hearing person in her deaf family. When the family's fishing business is threatened, Ruby finds herself torn between pursuing her love of music and her fear of abandoning her parents.

movies.title: Akira

details.tagline: Neo-Tokyo is about to E.X.P.L.O.D.E.

movies.description: A secret military project endangers Neo-Tokyo when it turns a biker gang member into a rampaging psychic psychopath that only two teenagers and a group of psychics can stop.

movies.title: The Invisible Guest

details.tagline: Every story has two sides. The truth, only one.

movies.description: Barcelona, Spain. Adrián Doria, a young and successful businessman accused of murder, meets one night with Virginia Goodman, an expert interrogation lawyer, in order to devise a defense strategy.

movies.title: Tokyo Story

details.tagline: As long as life goes on, relationships between parents and children will bring boundless joy and endless grief.

movies.description: The elderly Shukishi and his wife, Tomi, take the long journey from their small seaside village to visit their adult children in Tokyo. Their elder son, Koichi, a doctor, and their daughter, Shige, a hairdresser, don't have much time to spend with their aged parents, and so it falls to Noriko, the widow of their younger son who was killed in the war, to keep her in-laws company.

movies.title: Planet of the Apes

details.tagline: Somewhere in the Universe, there must be something better than man!
details.writers: Pierre Boulle, Michael Wilson, Rod Serling

movies.description: Astronaut Taylor crash lands on a distant planet ruled by apes who use a primitive race of humans for experimentation and sport. Soon Taylor finds himself among the hunted, his life in the hands of a benevolent chimpanzee scientist.

movies.title: In the Mood for Love

details.tagline: Feel the heat, keep the feeling burning, let the sensation explode.

castDetails.name: Joe Cheung Tung-Cho
castDetails.character: Man Living in Mr. Koo's Apartment

movies.description: In 1960s Hong Kong, two neighbors form an intimate bond after making a discovery about their spouses in this visually stunning tale of unrequited love.

movies.title: JFK

details.tagline: The story that won't go away.
details.writers: Zachary Sklar, Oliver Stone, Jim Marrs, Jim Garrison

movies.description: Follows the investigation into the assassination of President John F. Kennedy led by New Orleans district attorney Jim Garrison.

movies.title: Fanny and Alexander
movies.description: As children in the loving Ekdahl family, Fanny and Alexander enjoy a happy life with their parents, who run a theater company. After their father dies unexpectedly, however, the siblings end up in a joyless home when their mother, Emilie, marries a stern bishop. The bleak situation gradually grows worse as the bishop becomes more controlling, but dedicated relatives make a valiant attempt to aid Emilie, Fanny and Alexander.

movies.title: Stalker

details.tagline: There's no need to speak. You must only...concentrate and recall all your past life. When a man thinks of the past, he becomes kinder.
details.writers: Arkadiy Strugatskiy, Andrei Tarkovsky, Boris Strugatskiy, Arseny Tarkovsky

movies.description: Near a gray and unnamed city is the Zone, a place guarded by barbed wire and soldiers, and where the normal laws of physics are victim to frequent anomalies. A stalker guides two men into the Zone, specifically to an area in which deep-seated desires are granted.

movies.title: The Message

details.country: Algeria, Kuwait, Libyan Arab Jamahiriya, Morocco, Saudi Arabia
details.writers: Abdel Hamid Gouda El Sahhar, Tawfiq Al-Hakim, Abderrahman Charkawi, Mohamed Ali Maher

movies.description: In sixth-century Mecca, Prophet Muhammad receives his first revelation from God as a messenger. Three years later, he's not alone in his quest and publicly declares his prophecy. Muhammad is fought by Abu Sufian and his wife Hind, rulers of Mecca. Muhammad's followers are hunted and tortured but he continues his calling.

movies.title: Persona

details.tagline: Ingmar Bergman's most personal and original film.

movies.description: A young nurse, Alma, is put in charge of Elisabeth Vogler: an actress who is seemingly healthy in all respects, but will not talk. As they spend time together, Alma speaks to Elisabeth constantly, never receiving any answer.

movies.title: Infernal Affairs

details.tagline: Loyalty. Honor. Betrayal.
details.writers: Felix Chong Man-Keung, Alan Mak Siu-Fai

movies.description: Chan Wing Yan, a young police officer, has been sent undercover as a mole in the local mafia. Lau Kin Ming, a young mafia member, infiltrates the police force. Years later, their older counterparts, Chen Wing Yan and Inspector Lau Kin Ming, respectively, race against time to expose the mole within their midst.

movies.title: The 400 Blows

details.tagline: Angel faces hell-bent for violence.

collection.name: The Adventures of Antoine Doinel Collection

movies.description: For young Parisian boy Antoine Doinel, life is one difficult situation after another. Surrounded by inconsiderate adults, including his neglectful parents, Antoine spends his days with his best friend, Rene, trying to plan for a better life. When one of their schemes goes awry, Antoine ends up in trouble with the law, leading to even more conflicts with unsympathetic authority figures.

movies.title: 8½

details.tagline: A picture that goes beyond what men think about - because no man ever thought about it in quite this way!
details.writers: Federico Fellini, Ennio Flaiano, Tullio Pinelli, Brunello Rondi

movies.description: Guido Anselmi, a film director, finds himself creatively barren at the peak of his career. Urged by his doctors to rest, Anselmi heads for a luxurious resort, but a sorry group gathers—his producer, staff, actors, wife, mistress, and relatives—each one begging him to get on with the show. In retreat from their dependency, he fantasizes about past women and dreams of his childhood.

movies.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire

details.originalTitle: Portrait de la jeune fille en feu
details.tagline: Don't regret. Remember.

movies.description: On an isolated island in Brittany at the end of the eighteenth century, a female painter is obliged to paint a wedding portrait of a young woman.

movies.title: Three Colors: Red

details.tagline: The invisible thread of destinies.
details.writers: Krzysztof Kieślowski, Krzysztof Piesiewicz, Edward Żebrowski, Agnieszka Holland
