details.tagline: Evolution becomes revolution.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: A highly intelligent chimpanzee named Caesar has been living a peaceful suburban life ever since he was born. But when he gets taken to a cruel primate facility, Caesar decides to revolt against those who have harmed him.

movies.title: Kung Fu Panda

details.tagline: Prepare for awesomeness.
details.writers: Glenn Berger, Ethan Reiff, Jennifer Yuh Nelson, Cyrus Voris

movies.description: Chosen by prophecy but doubted by all, Po is an unlikely choice for the mystical title of the Dragon Warrior—a clumsy panda thrust into the world of kung fu as a deadly enemy threatens the Valley of Peace. Under reluctant guidance by Master Shifu and the Furious Five, Po must embrace who he is to unlock the power that no scroll can teach.

movies.title: The Fifth Element

details.tagline: There is no future without it.

movies.description: In 2257, a taxi driver is unintentionally given the task of saving a young girl who is part of the key that will ensure the survival of humanity.

movies.title: Moneyball

details.tagline: What are you really worth?
details.writers: Aaron Sorkin, Steven Zaillian, Stan Chervin, Brian A. Alexander

movies.description: The story of Oakland Athletics general manager Billy Beane's successful attempt to put together a baseball team on a budget, by employing computer-generated analysis to draft his players.

movies.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes

details.tagline: The future is worth fighting for.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
details.writers: Amanda Silver, Mark Bomback, Rick Jaffa

movies.description: A group of scientists in San Francisco struggle to stay alive in the aftermath of a plague that is wiping out humanity, while Caesar tries to maintain dominance over his community of intelligent apes.

movies.title: Midnight in Paris

details.tagline: Anything can happen in the city of light.
details.country: France, Spain, United States of America

movies.description: While on a trip to Paris with his fiancée's family, a nostalgic screenwriter finds himself mysteriously going back to the 1920s every day at midnight.

movies.title: A Star Is Born

details.writers: Bradley Cooper, Will Fetters, Robert Carson, William A. Wellman

movies.description: Seasoned musician Jackson Maine discovers — and falls in love with — struggling artist Ally. She has just about given up on her dream to make it big as a singer — until Jack coaxes her into the spotlight. But even as Ally's career takes off, the personal side of their relationship is breaking down, as Jack fights an ongoing battle with his own internal demons.

movies.title: Moana

details.tagline: The ocean is calling.
details.writers: David G. Derrick Jr., John Musker, Jared Bush, Aaron Kandell

movies.description: In Ancient Polynesia, when a terrible curse incurred by Maui reaches an impetuous Chieftain's daughter's island, she answers the Ocean's call to seek out the demigod to set things right.

movies.title: One Battle After Another

details.tagline: Some search for battle, others are born into it...

movies.description: Washed-up revolutionary Bob exists in a state of stoned paranoia, surviving off-grid with his spirited, self-reliant daughter, Willa. When his evil nemesis resurfaces after 16 years and she goes missing, the former radical scrambles to find her, father and daughter both battling the consequences of his past.

movies.title: Die Hard: With a Vengeance

details.tagline: Think fast. Look alive. Die hard.

movies.description: New York detective John McClane is back and kicking bad-guy butt in the third installment of this action-packed series, which finds him teaming with civilian Zeus Carver to prevent the loss of innocent lives. McClane thought he'd seen it all, until a genius named Simon engages McClane, his new "partner" -- and his beloved city -- in a deadly game that demands their concentration.

movies.title: The Others

details.tagline: Sooner or later they’ll find you.
details.country: Spain, United States of America, France

movies.description: Grace is a religious woman who lives in an old house kept dark because her two children, Anne and Nicholas, have a rare sensitivity to light. When the family begins to suspect the house is haunted, Grace fights to protect her children at any cost in the face of strange events and disturbing visions.

movies.title: Inside Man

details.tagline: It looked like the perfect bank robbery. But you can’t judge a crime by its cover.

movies.description: When an armed, masked gang enter a Manhattan bank, lock the doors and take hostages, the detective assigned to effect their release enters negotiations preoccupied with corruption charges he is facing.

movies.title: John Wick: Chapter 4

details.tagline: No way back, one way out.
details.language: Arabic, Cantonese, English, French, German, Japanese, Latin, Russian, Spanish
details.writers: Shay Hatten, Michael Finch, Derek Kolstad

movies.description: With the price on his head ever increasing, John Wick uncovers a path to defeating The High Table. But before he can earn his freedom, Wick must face off against a new enemy with powerful alliances across the globe and forces that turn old friends into foes.

movies.title: F1

details.tagline: Let's ride.

movies.description: Racing legend Sonny Hayes is coaxed out of retirement to lead a struggling Formula 1 team—and mentor a young hotshot driver—while chasing one more chance at glory.

movies.title: The Blind Side

details.tagline: Based on the extraordinary true story

movies.description: The story of Michael Oher, a homeless and traumatized boy who became an All American football player and first round NFL draft pick with the help of a caring woman and her family.

movies.title: True Grit

details.tagline: Punishment comes one way or another.
details.writers: Joel Coen, Ethan Coen, Charles Portis

movies.description: Following the murder of her father by a hired hand, a 14-year-old farm girl sets out to capture the killer. To aid her, she hires the toughest U.S. Marshal she can find—a man with 'true grit'—Reuben J. 'Rooster' Cogburn.

movies.title: 3:10 to Yuma

details.tagline: Time waits for one man.
details.writers: Derek Haas, Michael Brandt, Halsted Welles, Elmore Leonard

movies.description: In Arizona in the late 1800s, infamous outlaw Ben Wade and his vicious gang of thieves and murderers have plagued the Southern Railroad. When Wade is captured, Civil War veteran Dan Evans, struggling to survive on his drought-plagued ranch, volunteers to deliver him alive to the "3:10 to Yuma", a train that will take the killer to trial.

movies.title: Bridge of Spies

details.tagline: In the shadow of war, one man showed the world what we stand for.
details.country: United States of America, Germany, India
details.writers: Joel Coen, Ethan Coen, Matt Charman

movies.description: During the Cold War, the Soviet Union captures U.S. pilot Francis Gary Powers after shooting down his U-2 spy plane. Sentenced to 10 years in prison, Powers' only hope is New York lawyer James Donovan, recruited by a CIA operative to negotiate his release. Donovan boards a plane to Berlin, hoping to win the young man's freedom through a prisoner exchange. If all goes well, the Russians would get Rudolf Abel, the convicted spy who Donovan defended in court.

movies.title: Creed

details.tagline: Your legacy is more than a name.
details.writers: Aaron Covington, Ryan Coogler, Sylvester Stallone

movies.description: The former World Heavyweight Champion Rocky Balboa serves as a trainer and mentor to Adonis Johnson, the son of his late friend and former rival Apollo Creed.

movies.title: The Royal Tenenbaums

details.tagline: Family isn't a word... it's a sentence.

movies.description: Royal Tenenbaum and his wife Etheline had three children and then they separated. All three children are extraordinary --- all geniuses. Virtually all memory of the brilliance of the young Tenenbaums was subsequently erased by two decades of betrayal, failure, and disaster. Most of this was generally considered to be their father's fault. "The Royal Tenenbaums" is the story of the family's sudden, unexpected reunion one recent winter.

movies.title: Mission: Impossible - Dead Reckoning Part One

details.tagline: We all share the same fate.
details.writers: Bruce Geller, Christopher McQuarrie, Erik Jendresen

movies.description: Ethan Hunt and his IMF team embark on their most dangerous mission yet: To track down a terrifying new weapon that threatens all of humanity before it falls into the wrong hands. With control of the future and the world's fate at stake and dark forces from Ethan's past closing in, a deadly race around the globe begins. Confronted by a mysterious, all-powerful enemy, Ethan must consider that nothing can matter more than his mission—not even the lives of those he cares about most.

movies.title: Toy Story 4

details.tagline: The adventure of a lifetime.
details.writers: John Lasseter, Josh Cooley, Valerie LaPointe, Andrew Stanton

movies.description: Woody has always been confident about his place in the world, devoted to taking care of his kid—whether that's Andy or Bonnie. But after Bonnie creates a reluctant new toy called "Forky", a road trip adventure alongside old and new friends challenges everything Woody believes about loyalty, purpose, and what it truly means to be a toy.

movies.title: Train to Busan

details.tagline: Life-or-death survival begins.

movies.description: When a zombie virus pushes Korea into a state of emergency, those trapped on an express train to Busan must fight for their own survival.

movies.title: The Little Mermaid

details.tagline: Somewhere under the sea and beyond your imagination is an adventure in fantasy.
details.writers: John Musker, Ron Clements, Roger Allers, Ed Gombert

movies.description: This colorful adventure tells the story of an impetuous mermaid princess named Ariel who falls in love with the very human Prince Eric and puts everything on the line for the chance to be with him. Memorable songs and characters -- including the villainous sea witch Ursula.

movies.title: Gone Baby Gone

details.tagline: Everyone wants the truth... until they find it.
details.writers: Aaron Stockard, Dennis Lehane, Ben Affleck

movies.description: When 4 year old Amanda McCready disappears from her home and the police make little headway in solving the case, the girl's aunt, Beatrice McCready hires two private detectives, Patrick Kenzie and Angie Gennaro. The detectives freely admit that they have little experience with this type of case, but the family wants them for two reasons—they're not cops and they know the tough neighborhood in which they all live.

movies.title: Office Space

details.tagline: Work sucks.

movies.description: A depressed white-collar worker tries hypnotherapy, only to find himself in a perpetual state of devil-may-care bliss that prompts him to start living by his own rules, and hatch a hapless attempt to embezzle money from his soul-killing employers.

movies.title: Road to Perdition

details.tagline: Pray for Michael Sullivan.
details.writers: David Self, Richard Piers Rayner, Max Allan Collins

movies.description: Mike Sullivan works as a hit man for crime boss John Rooney. Sullivan views Rooney as a father figure, however after his son is witness to a killing, Mike Sullivan finds himself on the run in attempt to save the life of his son and at the same time looking for revenge on those who wronged him.

movies.title: The Banshees of Inisherin

details.tagline: Everything was fine yesterday.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America, Ireland

movies.description: Two lifelong friends find themselves at an impasse when one abruptly ends their relationship, with alarming consequences for both of them.

movies.title: Lethal Weapon

details.tagline: If these two can learn to stand each other... the bad guys don't stand a chance.

movies.description: A veteran cop and an unstable detective become partners who must put their differences aside in order to bring down a heroin-smuggling ring run by ex-Special Forces.

movies.title: Hell or High Water

details.tagline: Blood always follows money.

movies.description: A divorced dad and his ex-con brother resort to a desperate scheme in order to save their family's farm in West Texas.

movies.title: Eastern Promises

details.tagline: Every sin leaves a mark.
details.country: Canada, United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: A Russian teenager living in London dies during childbirth but leaves clues in her diary that could tie her child to a rape involving a violent Russian mob family.

movies.title: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs

details.tagline: The Happiest, Dopiest, Grumpiest, Sneeziest movie of the year.
details.writers: Merrill De Maris, Earl Hurd, Dick Rickard, Ted Sears

movies.description: A beautiful girl, Snow White, takes refuge in the forest in the house of seven dwarfs to hide from her stepmother, the wicked Queen. The Queen is jealous because she wants to be known as "the fairest in the land," and Snow White's beauty surpasses her own.

movies.title: The Raid

details.tagline: 1 Ruthless Crime Lord, 20 Elite Cops, 30 Floors of Hell.
details.country: Indonesia, France, United States of America

movies.description: Deep in the heart of Jakarta's slums lies an impenetrable safe house for the world's most dangerous killers and gangsters. Until now, the run-down apartment block has been considered untouchable to even the bravest of police. Cloaked under the cover of pre-dawn darkness and silence, an elite swat team is tasked with raiding the safe house in order to take down the notorious drug lord that runs it.  But when a chance encounter with a spotter blows their cover and news of their assault reaches the drug lord, the building's lights are cut and all the exits blocked. Stranded on the sixth floor with no way out, the unit must fight their way through the city's worst to survive their mission. Starring Indonesian martial arts sensation Iko Uwais.

movies.title: Godzilla Minus One

details.tagline: 戦後、日本。無（ゼロ）から負（マイナス）へ。

movies.description: In postwar Japan, Godzilla brings new devastation to an already scorched landscape. With no military intervention or government help in sight, the survivors must join together in the face of despair and fight back against an unrelenting horror.

movies.title: Run Lola Run

details.tagline: Every second of every day you're faced with a decision that can change your life.

movies.description: Lola receives a phone call from her boyfriend Manni. He lost 100,000 DM in a subway train that belongs to a very bad guy. She has 20 minutes to raise this amount and meet Manni. Otherwise, he will rob a store to get the money. Three different alternatives may happen depending on some minor event along Lola's run.

movies.title: What We Do in the Shadows

details.tagline: Some interviews with some vampires.
details.country: New Zealand, United States of America

movies.description: Vampire housemates try to cope with the complexities of modern life and show a newly turned hipster some of the perks of being undead.

movies.title: The Jungle Book

details.tagline: The Jungle is JUMPIN'!
details.writers: Rudyard Kipling, Larry Clemmons, Ralph Wright, Ken Anderson

movies.description: The boy Mowgli makes his way to the man-village with Bagheera, the wise panther. Along the way he meets jazzy King Louie, the hypnotic snake Kaa and the lovable, happy-go-lucky bear Baloo, who teaches Mowgli "The Bare Necessities" of life and the true meaning of friendship.

movies.title: Mad Max 2

details.tagline: Just one man can make a difference.
details.writers: George Miller, Terry Hayes, Brian Hannant, Byron Kennedy

movies.description: Max Rockatansky returns as the heroic loner who drives the dusty roads of a postapocalyptic Australian Outback in an unending search for gasoline. Arrayed against him and the other scraggly defendants of a fuel-depot encampment are the bizarre warriors commanded by the charismatic Lord Humungus, a violent leader whose scruples are as barren as the surrounding landscape.

movies.title: Adaptation.

details.tagline: From the creator of Being John Malkovich, comes the story about the creator of Being John Malkovich.

movies.description: Charlie Kaufman is a confused L.A. screenwriter overwhelmed by feelings of inadequacy, sexual frustration, self-loathing, and by the screenwriting ambitions of his freeloading twin brother Donald. While struggling to adapt "The Orchid Thief," by Susan Orlean, Kaufman's life spins from pathetic to bizarre. The lives of Kaufman and Orlean's book become strangely intertwined as each one's search for passion collides with the other's.

movies.title: The Thin Red Line

details.tagline: Every man fights his own war.

movies.description: The story of a group of men, an Army Rifle company called C-for-Charlie, who change, suffer, and ultimately make essential discoveries about themselves during the fierce World War II battle of Guadalcanal. It follows their journey, from the surprise of an unopposed landing, through the bloody and exhausting battles that follow, to the ultimate departure of those who survived.

movies.title: The Last of the Mohicans

details.tagline: An epic adventure and passionate romance unfold against the panorama of a frontier wilderness ravaged by war.
details.writers: Michael Mann, Christopher Crowe, James Fenimore Cooper, Jeff Balsmeyer

movies.description: In war-torn colonial America, in the midst of a bloody battle between British, the French and Native American allies, the aristocratic daughter of a British Colonel and her party are captured by a group of Huron warriors. Fortunately, a group of three Mohican trappers comes to their rescue.

movies.title: Rushmore

details.tagline: Love. Expulsion. Revolution.

movies.description: When a beautiful first-grade teacher arrives at a prep school, she soon attracts the attention of an ambitious teenager named Max, who quickly falls in love with her. Max turns to the father of two of his schoolmates for advice on how to woo the teacher. However, the situation soon gets complicated when Max's new friend becomes involved with her, setting the two pals against one another in a war for her attention.

movies.title: Thelma & Louise

details.tagline: Somebody said get a life...so they did.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America, France

movies.description: Taking a break from their dreary lives, close friends Thelma and Louise embark on a short weekend trip that ends in unforeseen incriminating circumstances. As fugitives, both women rediscover the strength of their bond and their newfound resilience.

movies.title: Searching

details.tagline: No one is lost without a trace.

movies.description: After David Kim's 16-year-old daughter goes missing, a local investigation is opened and a detective is assigned to the case. But 37 hours later and without a single lead, David decides to search the one place no one has looked yet, where all secrets are kept today: his daughter's laptop.

movies.title: Ponyo

details.tagline: Welcome to a world where anything is possible.

movies.description: When Sosuke, a young boy who lives on a clifftop overlooking the sea, rescues a stranded goldfish named Ponyo, he discovers more than he bargained for. Ponyo is a curious, energetic young creature who yearns to be human, but even as she causes chaos around the house, her father, a powerful sorcerer, schemes to return Ponyo to the sea.

movies.title: Roma

details.tagline: There are periods in history that scar societies and moments in life that transform us as individuals.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: In 1970s Mexico City, two domestic workers help a mother of four while her husband is away for an extended period of time.

movies.title: Blue Is the Warmest Color

details.tagline: To love.
details.writers: Abdellatif Kechiche, Ghalya Lacroix, Jul Maroh

movies.description: Adèle's life is changed when she meets Emma, a young woman with blue hair, who will allow her to discover desire, to assert herself as a woman and as an adult. In front of others, Adele grows, seeks herself, loses herself, finds herself.

movies.title: Guillermo del Toro's Pinocchio

details.tagline: Love will give you life.
details.writers: Matthew Robbins, Carlo Collodi, Guillermo del Toro, Vera Brosgol

castDetails.name: Tom Kenny
castDetails.character: Mussolini / Right Hand Man / Sea Captain (voice)

movies.description: During the rise of fascism in Mussolini's Italy, a wooden boy brought magically to life struggles to live up to his father's expectations.

movies.title: The French Connection

details.tagline: Doyle is bad news—but a good cop.

movies.description: Tough narcotics detective 'Popeye' Doyle is in hot pursuit of a suave French drug dealer who may be the key to a huge heroin-smuggling operation.

movies.title: The Florida Project

details.tagline: Find your kingdom.

movies.description: The story of a precocious six year-old and her ragtag group of friends whose summer break is filled with childhood wonder, possibility and a sense of adventure while the adults around them struggle with hard times.

movies.title: Aftersun

details.tagline: Memory burns.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: Sophie reflects on the shared joy and private melancholy of a holiday she took with her father twenty years earlier. Memories fill the gaps between camcorder footages as she tries to reconcile the father she knew with the troubled man she didn't.

movies.title: Deliverance

details.tagline: What did happen on the Cahulawassee River?

movies.description: Intent on seeing the Cahulawassee River before it's turned into one huge lake, outdoor fanatic Lewis Medlock takes his friends on a river-rafting trip they'll never forget into the dangerous American back-country.

movies.title: Enter the Dragon

details.tagline: Their deadly mission: to crack the forbidden island of Han!
details.country: Hong Kong, United States of America

movies.description: A martial artist agrees to spy on a reclusive crime lord using his invitation to a tournament there as cover.

movies.title: Philomena

details.tagline: These two unlikely companions are on a journey to find her long lost son.
details.writers: Jeff Pope, Steve Coogan, Martin Sixsmith

movies.description: A woman searches for her adult son, who was taken away from her decades ago when she was forced to live in a convent.

movies.title: The Bridges of Madison County

details.tagline: A love like this happens to some of us sooner or later. For Robert and Francesca, it was later.
details.writers: Robert James Waller, Richard LaGravenese, Steven Spielberg, Clint Eastwood

movies.description: Photographer Robert Kincaid wanders into the life of housewife Francesca Johnson for four days in the 1960s.

movies.title: Breathless

details.tagline: Wild! Violent! Outspoken and Honest!
details.writers: Jean-Luc Godard, François Truffaut, Claude Chabrol

movies.description: A small-time thief steals a car and impulsively murders a motorcycle policeman. Wanted by the authorities, he attempts to persuade a girl to run away to Italy with him.

movies.title: All of Us Strangers

details.tagline: All of us hurt. All of us hope. All of us love.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: One night in his near-empty tower block in contemporary London, Adam has a chance encounter with a mysterious neighbor, which punctures the rhythm of his everyday life.

movies.title: Mustang

details.tagline: Their spirit would never be broken.

movies.description: In a Turkish village, five orphaned sisters live under strict rule while members of their family prepare their arranged marriages.

movies.title: On Golden Pond

details.tagline: When life is at its finest... when love is at its fullest...

movies.description: For Norman and Ethel Thayer, this summer on golden pond is filled with conflict and resolution. When their daughter Chelsea arrives, the family is forced to renew the bonds of love and overcome the generational friction that has existed for years.

movies.title: Loveless

details.tagline: A missing child. A marriage destroyed. A country in crisis.

movies.description: Zhenya and Boris are going through a vicious divorce marked by resentment, frustration and recriminations. Already embarking on new lives, each with a new partner, they are impatient to start again, to turn the page – even if it means threatening to abandon their 12-year-old son Alyosha. Until, after witnessing one of their fights, Alyosha disappears.

movies.title: Les Misérables

details.writers: Ladj Ly, Giordano Gederlini, Alexis Manenti

movies.description: Stéphane has recently joined the Anti-Crime Squad in Montfermeil, in the suburbs of Paris, France, where Victor Hugo set his famed novel “Les Miserables”. Alongside his new colleagues Chris and Gwada – both experienced members of the team – he quickly discovers tensions running high between local gangs. When the trio finds themselves overrun during the course of an arrest, a drone captures the encounter, threatening to expose the reality of everyday life.

movies.title: Robot Dreams

details.tagline: Experience a once-in-a-lifetime friendship beyond your wildest dreams

movies.description: A lonely dog's friendship with his robot companion takes a sad turn when an unexpected malfunction forces him to abandon Robot at the beach. Will Dog ever meet Robot again?

movies.title: The Insult

details.tagline: Words change everything.

movies.description: After an emotional exchange between a Lebanese Christian and a Palestinian refugee escalates, the men end up in a court case that gets national attention.

movies.title: Doctor Strange

details.tagline: The impossibilities are endless.
details.writers: Jon Spaihts, Scott Derrickson, C. Robert Cargill, Steve Ditko

movies.description: After his career is destroyed, a brilliant but arrogant surgeon gets a new lease on life when a sorcerer takes him under her wing and trains him to defend the world against evil.

movies.title: Spider-Man 2

details.tagline: There's a hero in all of us.
details.writers: Alvin Sargent, Michael Chabon, Alfred Gough, Miles Millar

movies.description: Peter Parker is going through a major identity crisis. Burned out from being Spider-Man, he decides to shelve his superhero alter ego, which leaves the city suffering in the wake of carnage left by the evil Doc Ock. In the meantime, Parker still can't act on his feelings for Mary Jane Watson, a girl he's loved since childhood. A certain anger begins to brew in his best friend Harry Osborn as well...

movies.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire

details.tagline: Remember who the enemy is.
details.writers: Simon Beaufoy, Suzanne Collins, Michael Arndt

movies.description: After surviving the Hunger Games, Katniss and Peeta struggle with the consequences of their victory as unrest spreads across Panem. Forced back into the spotlight, they become symbols of hope and resistance while the Capitol prepares a new and deadly challenge that will change the future of the nation forever.

movies.title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets

details.tagline: Something evil has returned to Hogwarts!
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America, Germany

movies.description: Cars fly, trees fight back, and a mysterious house-elf comes to warn Harry Potter at the start of his second year at Hogwarts. Adventure and danger await when bloody writing on a wall announces: The Chamber Of Secrets Has Been Opened. To save Hogwarts will require all of Harry, Ron and Hermione's magical abilities and courage.

movies.title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

details.tagline: The rebellion begins.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: When a new professor's methods leave Hogwarts unprepared to fight the rising tide of evil, Harry teaches students how to defend against the dark arts.

movies.title: Sherlock Holmes

details.tagline: Nothing escapes him.
details.writers: Michael Robert Johnson, Arthur Conan Doyle, Simon Kinberg, Lionel Wigram

movies.description: Eccentric consulting detective Sherlock Holmes and Doctor John Watson battle to bring down a new nemesis and unravel a deadly plot that could destroy England.

movies.title: Zombieland

details.tagline: Nut up or shut up.

movies.description: Columbus has made a habit of running from what scares him. Tallahassee doesn't have fears. If he did, he'd kick their ever-living ass. In a world overrun by zombies, these two are perfectly evolved survivors. But now, they're about to stare down the most terrifying prospect of all: each other.

movies.title: Avatar: The Way of Water

details.tagline: Return to Pandora.
details.writers: James Cameron, Josh Friedman, Rick Jaffa, Amanda Silver

movies.description: Set more than a decade after the events of the first film, learn the story of the Sully family (Jake, Neytiri, and their kids), the trouble that follows them, the lengths they go to keep each other safe, the battles they fight to stay alive, and the tragedies they endure.

movies.title: Deadpool & Wolverine

details.tagline: Come together.
details.writers: Rhett Reese, Paul Wernick, Ryan Reynolds, Shawn Levy

movies.description: A listless Wade Wilson toils away in civilian life with his days as the morally flexible mercenary, Deadpool, behind him. But when his homeworld faces an existential threat, Wade must reluctantly suit-up again with an even more reluctant Wolverine.

movies.title: Source Code

details.tagline: Make every second count.

movies.description: When decorated soldier Captain Colter Stevens wakes up in the body of an unknown man, he discovers he's part of a mission to find the bomber of a Chicago commuter train.

movies.title: Love Actually

details.tagline: Love actually is all around.

movies.description: Eight very different couples deal with their love lives in various loosely interrelated tales all set during a frantic month before Christmas in London.

movies.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom

details.tagline: If adventure has a name... it must be Indiana Jones.
details.writers: Gloria Katz, Willard Huyck, George Lucas, Philip Kaufman

movies.description: After arriving in India, Indiana Jones is asked by a desperate village to find a mystical stone. He agrees – and stumbles upon a secret cult plotting a terrible plan in the catacombs of an ancient palace.

movies.title: Ice Age

details.tagline: Sub-zero heroes.
details.writers: Michael Berg, Michael J. Wilson, Peter Ackerman, Yvette Kaplan

movies.description: Manny the mammoth, Sid the loquacious sloth, and Diego the sabre-toothed tiger go on a comical quest to return a human baby back to his father, across a world on the brink of an ice age.

movies.title: Sinners

details.tagline: Dance with the devil.

movies.description: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.

movies.title: Back to the Future Part III

details.tagline: They've saved the best trip for last... But this time they may have gone too far.

movies.description: The final installment finds Marty digging the trusty DeLorean out of a mineshaft and looking for Doc in the Wild West of 1885. But when their time machine breaks down, the travelers are stranded in a land of spurs. More problems arise when Doc falls for pretty schoolteacher Clara Clayton, and Marty tangles with Buford Tannen.

movies.title: Gangs of New York

details.tagline: America was born in the streets.
details.writers: Jay Cocks, Kenneth Lonergan, Steven Zaillian

movies.description: In early 1860s New York, Irish immigrant Amsterdam Vallon is released from prison and returns to the Five Points, seeking revenge against his father's killer, William Cutting, a powerful anti-immigrant gang leader. He knows that revenge can only be attained by infiltrating Cutting's inner circle. Vallon's journey becomes a fight for personal survival and to find a place for the Irish people.

movies.title: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World

details.tagline: An epic of epic epicness.
details.country: Japan, United Kingdom, United States of America
details.writers: Michael Bacall, Bryan Lee O'Malley, Edgar Wright

movies.description: As bass guitarist for a garage-rock band, Scott Pilgrim has never had trouble getting a girlfriend; usually, the problem is getting rid of them. But when Ramona Flowers skates into his heart, he finds she has the most troublesome baggage of all: an army of ex-boyfriends who will stop at nothing to eliminate him from her list of suitors.

movies.title: The Hurt Locker

details.tagline: You don't have to be a hero to do this job. But it helps.
details.country: United States of America, United Kingdom

movies.description: During the Iraq War, a Sergeant recently assigned to an army bomb squad is put at odds with his squad mates due to his maverick way of handling his work.

movies.title: Collateral

details.tagline: It started like any other night.
details.writers: Stuart Beattie, Frank Darabont, Michael Mann

movies.description: Cab driver Max picks up a man who offers him $600 to drive him around. But the promise of easy money sours when Max realizes his fare is an assassin.

movies.title: The Godfather Part III

details.tagline: All the power on earth can't change destiny.

movies.description: In the midst of trying to legitimize his business dealings in 1979 New York and Italy, aging mafia don, Michael Corleone seeks forgiveness for his sins while taking a young protege under his wing.

movies.title: The Town

details.tagline: Welcome to the bank robbery capital of America.
details.writers: Ben Affleck, Peter Craig, Aaron Stockard, Chuck Hogan

movies.description: A proficient group of thieves rob a bank and hold the manager hostage. Things begin to get complicated when one of the crew members falls in love with her.

movies.title: Eyes Wide Shut

details.tagline: No dream is ever just a dream.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
details.writers: Stanley Kubrick, Frederic Raphael, Arthur Schnitzler

movies.description: After Dr. Bill Harford's wife, Alice, admits to having sexual fantasies about a man she met, Bill becomes obsessed with having a sexual encounter. He discovers an underground sexual group and attends one of their meetings -- and quickly discovers that he is in over his head.

movies.title: 127 Hours

details.tagline: Every second counts.
details.country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
details.writers: Simon Beaufoy, Danny Boyle, Aron Ralston, Rollo Armstrong

movies.description: The true story of mountain climber Aron Ralston's remarkable adventure to save himself after a fallen boulder crashes on his arm and traps him in an isolated canyon in Utah.

movies.title: The Aviator

details.tagline: Some men dream the future. He built it.
details.country: United States of America, Canada, Germany

movies.description: A biopic depicting the life of filmmaker and aviation pioneer Howard Hughes from 1927 to 1947, during which time he became a successful film producer and an aviation magnate, while simultaneously growing more unstable due to severe obsessive-compulsive disorder.

movies.title: Jackie Brown

details.tagline: This Christmas, Santa's got a brand new bag.

movies.description: Jackie Brown is a flight attendant who gets caught in the middle of smuggling cash into the country for her gunrunner boss. When the cops try to use Jackie to get to her boss, she hatches a plan — with help from a bail bondsman — to keep the money for herself.

movies.title: Total Recall

details.tagline: Get ready for the ride of your life.
details.writers: Dan O'Bannon, Ronald Shusett, Jon Povill, Gary Goldman

movies.description: Construction worker Douglas Quaid's obsession with the planet Mars leads him to visit Rekall, a virtual vacation company that manufactures memories. When something goes wrong during Quaid's memory implant procedure, his life turns upside down, leading him to question what is reality and what isn't.

movies.title: Incredibles 2

details.tagline: It's been too long, dahlings.
details.writers: Brad Bird, Dean Kelly, Sanjay Patel, Brian Kalin O'Connell

movies.description: Elastigirl springs into action to save the day, while Mr. Incredible faces his greatest challenge yet – taking care of the problems of his three children.

movies.title: Les Misérables

details.tagline: Fight. Dream. Hope. Love.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
details.writers: Victor Hugo, William Nicholson, Claude-Michel Schönberg, Alain Boublil

movies.description: An adaptation of the successful stage musical based on Victor Hugo's classic novel set in 19th-century France. Jean Valjean, a man imprisoned for stealing bread, must flee a relentless policeman named Javert. The pursuit consumes both men's lives, and soon Valjean finds himself in the midst of the student revolutions in France.

movies.title: The Greatest Showman

details.tagline: The impossible comes true.

movies.description: The story of American showman P.T. Barnum, founder of the circus that became the famous traveling Ringling Bros. and Barnum & Bailey Circus.

movies.title: Hugo

details.tagline: One of the most legendary directors of our time takes you on an extraordinary adventure.

movies.description: Orphaned and alone except for an uncle, Hugo Cabret lives in the walls of a train station in 1930s Paris. Hugo's job is to oil and maintain the station's clocks, but to him, his more important task is to protect a broken automaton and notebook left to him by his late father. Accompanied by the goddaughter of an embittered toy merchant, Hugo embarks on a quest to solve the mystery of the automaton and find a place he can call home.

movies.title: BlacKkKlansman

details.tagline: Infiltrate hate.
details.writers: David Rabinowitz, Spike Lee, Kevin Willmott, Charlie Wachtel

movies.description: Colorado Springs, late 1970s. Ron Stallworth, an African American police officer, and Flip Zimmerman, his Jewish colleague, run an undercover operation to infiltrate the Ku Klux Klan.

movies.title: Contact

details.tagline: Take a journey to the heart of the universe.
details.writers: Michael Goldenberg, Carl Sagan, James V. Hart, Ann Druyan

movies.description: A radio astronomer receives the first extraterrestrial radio signal ever picked up on Earth. As the world powers scramble to decipher the message and decide upon a course of action, she must make some difficult decisions between her beliefs, the truth, and reality.

movies.title: Moulin Rouge!

details.tagline: The greatest thing you'll ever learn is just to love.... and be loved in return.

movies.description: A celebration of love and creative inspiration takes place in the infamous, gaudy and glamorous Parisian nightclub, at the cusp of the 20th century. A young poet, who is plunged into the heady world of Moulin Rouge, begins a passionate affair with the club's most notorious and beautiful star.

movies.title: I, Tonya

details.tagline: Fitting in is overrated.

movies.description: Competitive ice skater Tonya Harding rises amongst the ranks at the U.S. Figure Skating Championships, but her future in the sport is thrown into doubt when her ex-husband intervenes.

movies.title: The Favourite

details.tagline: A bawdy, brilliant triumph.
details.country: Ireland, United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: England, early 18th century. The close relationship between Queen Anne and Sarah Churchill is threatened by the arrival of Sarah's cousin, Abigail Hill, resulting in a bitter rivalry between the two cousins to be the Queen's favourite.

movies.title: Inside Out 2

details.tagline: Make room for new emotions.
details.writers: John Hoffman, Meg LeFauve, Kelsey Mann, Dave Holstein

movies.description: Teenager Riley's mind headquarters is undergoing a sudden demolition to make room for something entirely unexpected: new Emotions! Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear and Disgust, who’ve long been running a successful operation by all accounts, aren’t sure how to feel when Anxiety shows up. And it looks like she’s not alone.

movies.title: Promising Young Woman

details.tagline: Revenge never looked so promising.

movies.description: A young woman, traumatized by a tragic event in her past, seeks out vengeance against those who crossed her path.

movies.title: Master and Commander: The Far Side of the World

details.tagline: The courage to do the impossible lies in the hearts of men.
details.writers: John Collee, Peter Weir, Patrick O'Brian

movies.description: After an abrupt and violent encounter with a French warship inflicts severe damage upon his ship, a captain of the British Royal Navy begins a chase over two oceans to capture or destroy the enemy, though he must weigh his commitment to duty and ferocious pursuit of glory against the safety of his devoted crew, including the ship's thoughtful surgeon, his best friend.

movies.title: Munich

details.tagline: The world was watching in 1972 as 11 Israeli athletes were murdered at the Munich Olympics. This is the story of what happened next.
details.language: Arabic, German, Greek, English, French, Hebrew, Italian, Russian
details.country: United States of America, Canada, Hungary, France
details.writers: Tony Kushner, Eric Roth, George Jonas

movies.description: During the 1972 Olympic Games in Munich, eleven Israeli athletes are taken hostage and murdered by a Palestinian terrorist group known as Black September. In retaliation, the Israeli government recruits a group of Mossad agents to track down and execute those responsible for the attack.

movies.title: Erin Brockovich

details.tagline: She brought a small town to its feet and a huge company to its knees.

movies.description: A twice-divorced mother of three who sees an injustice, takes on the bad guy and wins -- with a little help from her push-up bra. Erin goes to work for an attorney and comes across medical records describing illnesses clustered in one nearby town. She starts investigating and soon exposes a monumental cover-up.

movies.title: Upgrade

details.tagline: Not man. Not machine. More.

movies.description: A brutal mugging leaves Grey Trace paralyzed in the hospital and his beloved wife dead. A billionaire inventor soon offers Trace a cure — an artificial intelligence implant called STEM that will enhance his body. Now able to walk, Grey finds that he also has superhuman strength and agility — skills he uses to seek revenge against the thugs who destroyed his life.

movies.title: Traffic

details.tagline: No one gets away clean

movies.description: An exploration of the United States of America's war on drugs from multiple perspectives. For the new head of the Office of National Drug Control Policy, the war becomes personal when he discovers his well-educated daughter is abusing cocaine within their comfortable suburban home. In Mexico, a flawed, but noble policeman agrees to testify against a powerful general in league with a cartel, and in San Diego, a drug kingpin's sheltered trophy wife must learn her husband's ruthless business after he is arrested, endangering her luxurious lifestyle.

movies.title: Sideways

details.tagline: In search of wine. In search of women. In search of themselves.
details.writers: Rex Pickett, Alexander Payne, Jim Taylor

movies.description: Two middle-aged men embark on a spiritual journey through Californian wine country. One is an unpublished novelist suffering from depression, and the other is only days away from walking down the aisle.

movies.title: The Abyss

details.tagline: When you get there, you will understand.

movies.description: A civilian oil rig crew is recruited to conduct a search and rescue effort when a nuclear submarine mysteriously sinks. One diver soon finds himself on a spectacular odyssey 25,000 feet below the ocean's surface where he confronts a mysterious force that has the power to change the world or destroy it.

movies.title: The Assassination of Jesse James by the Coward Robert Ford

details.tagline: Beyond the myth lies America's greatest betrayal
details.country: Canada, United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: Outlaw Jesse James is rumored to be the 'fastest gun in the West'. An eager recruit into James' notorious gang, Robert Ford eventually grows jealous of the famed outlaw and, when Robert and his brother sense an opportunity to kill James, their murderous action elevates their target to near mythical status.

movies.title: Breakfast at Tiffany's

details.tagline: Audrey Hepburn plays that daring, darling Holly Golightly to a new high in entertainment delight!

movies.description: Holly Golightly is an eccentric New York City playgirl determined to marry a Brazilian millionaire. But when young writer Paul Varjak moves into her apartment building, her past threatens to get in their way.

movies.title: Legends of the Fall

details.tagline: After the Fall from Innocence the Legend begins.
details.writers: William D. Wittliff, Jim Harrison, Susan Shilliday

movies.description: In early 20th-century Montana, Col. William Ludlow lives on a ranch in the wilderness with his sons, Alfred, Tristan, and Samuel. Eventually, the unconventional but close-knit family are bound by loyalty, tested by war, and torn apart by love, as told over the course of several decades in this epic saga.

movies.title: Milk

details.tagline: Never blend in.

movies.description: The true story of Harvey Milk, the first openly gay man ever elected to public office. In San Francisco in the late 1970s, Harvey Milk becomes an activist for gay rights and inspires others to join him in his fight for equal rights that should be available to all Americans.

movies.title: Trading Places

details.tagline: They're not just getting rich... They're getting even.

movies.description: A snobbish investor and a wily street con-artist find their positions reversed as part of a bet by two callous millionaires.

movies.title: Brooklyn

details.tagline: Two countries, two loves, one heart

movies.description: In 1950s Ireland and New York, young Eilis Lacey has to choose between two men and two countries.

movies.title: American Fiction

details.tagline: Once you go full black, you ain't never going back!

movies.description: A novelist fed up with the establishment profiting from "Black" entertainment uses a pen name to write a book that propels him into the heart of hypocrisy and the madness he claims to disdain.

movies.title: Robin Hood

details.tagline: Meet Robin Hood and his MERRY MENagerie!
details.writers: Ken Anderson, Roger Miller, George Bruns, Johnny Mercer

castDetails.name: Peter Ustinov
castDetails.character: Prince John - A Lion / King Richard (voice)

castDetails.name: Pat Buttram
castDetails.character: The Sheriff Of Nottingham - A Wolf (voice)

movies.description: With King Richard off to the Crusades, Prince John and his slithering minion, Sir Hiss, set about taxing Nottingham's citizens with support from the corrupt sheriff - and staunch opposition by the wily Robin Hood and his band of merry men.

movies.title: Field of Dreams

details.tagline: All his life, Ray Kinsella was searching for his dreams. Then one day, his dreams came looking for him.

movies.description: Ray Kinsella is an Iowa farmer who hears a mysterious voice telling him to turn his cornfield into a baseball diamond. He does, but the voice's directions don't stop -- even after the spirits of deceased ballplayers turn up to play.

movies.title: An American Werewolf in London

details.tagline: Beware the moon.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: American tourists David and Jack are savagely attacked by an unidentified animal while hiking on the Yorkshire Moors. After retiring to the home of a beautiful nurse to recuperate, David soon begins experiencing disturbing changes to his body and mind.

movies.title: tick, tick... BOOM!

details.tagline: How much time do we have to do something great?

movies.description: On the brink of turning 30, a promising theater composer navigates love, friendship and the pressure to create something great before time runs out.

movies.title: The Iron Claw

details.tagline: Sons. Brothers. Champions.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: The true story of the inseparable Von Erich brothers, who made history in the intensely competitive world of professional wrestling in the early 1980s. Through tragedy and triumph, under the shadow of their domineering father and coach, the brothers seek larger-than-life immortality on the biggest stage in sports.

movies.title: Headhunters

details.tagline: The hunt is on.
details.writers: Lars Gudmestad, Ulf Rydberg, Jo Nesbø

movies.description: An accomplished headhunter risks everything to obtain a valuable painting owned by a former mercenary.

movies.title: Selma

details.tagline: One dream can change the world.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: "Selma," as in Alabama, the place where segregation in the South was at its worst, leading to a march that ended in violence, forcing a famous statement by President Lyndon B. Johnson that ultimately led to the signing of the Voting Rights Act.

movies.title: Drive My Car

details.originalTitle: ドライブ・マイ・カー
details.tagline: Go on living.
details.language: Mandarin, English, German, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Tagalog
details.writers: Ryusuke Hamaguchi, Takamasa Oe, Haruki Murakami

movies.description: Yusuke Kafuku, a stage actor and director, still unable, after two years, to cope with the loss of his beloved wife, accepts to direct Uncle Vanya at a theater festival in Hiroshima. There he meets Misaki, an introverted young woman, appointed to drive his car. In between rides, secrets from the past and heartfelt confessions will be unveiled.

movies.title: The Farewell

details.tagline: Based on an actual lie.

movies.description: A headstrong Chinese-American woman returns to China when her beloved grandmother is given a terminal diagnosis. Billi struggles with her family's decision to keep grandma in the dark about her own illness as they all stage an impromptu wedding to see grandma one last time.

movies.title: Pain and Glory

details.tagline: Pain, Glory, Love, Art, Cinema

movies.description: Salvador Mallo, a filmmaker in the twilight of his career, remembers his life: his mother, his lovers, the actors he worked with. The sixties in a small village in Valencia, the eighties in Madrid, the present, when he feels an immeasurable emptiness, facing his mortality, the incapability of continuing filming, the impossibility of separating creation from his own life. The need of narrating his past can be his salvation.

movies.title: Cold War

details.language: German, Croatian, French, Italian, Polish, Russian
details.writers: Paweł Pawlikowski, Janusz Głowacki, Piotr Borkowski, Maria Pawlikowska

movies.description: A man and a woman meet in the ruins of post-war Poland. With vastly different backgrounds and temperaments, they are fatally mismatched and yet drawn to each other.

movies.title: Sophie's Choice

details.tagline: Between the innocent, the romantic, the sensual, and the unthinkable. There are still some things we have yet to imagine.
details.language: Czech, German, French, Polish, Russian, English
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: Stingo, a young writer, moves to Brooklyn in 1947 to begin work on his first novel. As he becomes friendly with Sophie and her lover Nathan, he learns that she is a Holocaust survivor. Flashbacks reveal her harrowing story, from pre-war prosperity to Auschwitz. In the present, Sophie and Nathan's relationship increasingly unravels as Stingo grows closer to Sophie and Nathan's fragile mental state becomes ever more apparent.

movies.title: Wadjda

details.tagline: I want you to be the happiest person in the world.

movies.description: An enterprising Saudi girl signs on for her school's Quran recitation competition as a way to raise the remaining funds she needs in order to buy the green bicycle that has captured her interest.

movies.title: Omar
movies.description: The drama, the story of three childhood friends and a young woman who are torn apart in their fight for freedom, is billed as the first fully-financed film to come out of the Palestinian cinema industry.

movies.title: The Yacoubian Building
movies.description: The lives of residents in an old Cairo building, "The Yacoubian Building," are affected by issues like corruption, extremism, class disparity, and sexuality. Through diverse characters, the film offers a critical examination of Egyptian society.

movies.title: Cairo Station

details.writers: Abdel Hai Adib, Mohamed Abu Youssef

movies.description: Qinawi, a physically challenged peddler who makes his living selling newspapers in the central Cairo train station, is obsessed with Hanuma, an attractive young woman who sells drinks. While she jokes with him about a possible relationship, she is actually in love with Abu Siri, a strong and respected porter at the station who is struggling to unionize his fellow workers to combat their boss' exploitative and abusive treatment.

movies.title: Hajjan

details.writers: Mufarrij Almajfel, Omar Shama, Abu Bakr Shawky, Zeinab Ghareeb

movies.description: In the world of camel racing, Ghanim is preparing for the Great Race of Safwa.  His younger brother, Matar, grew up hearing these poems about their legendary grandfather, known only as "Hajjan," the Arabic word for jockey. But as he follows in his grandfather's footsteps, in a regional qualifying race, foul play interrupts Ghanim's dreams.  Matar realizes that the only chance to save himself and his inseparable camel Hofir is to also become a "Hajjan", and enter the world of Bedouin camel racing — where heroes are made.

movies.title: Clash

details.tagline: Conflict is on the inside.

movies.description: In 2013, in Cairo, a tragic fate brings together several detainees from different political and social backgrounds inside a police truck, during the turmoil that followed the ousting of president Morsi.

movies.title: Captain Abu Raed

details.tagline: A humanistic triumph...

movies.description: Abu Raed is an old airport janitor who has always yearned to travel the world but has never been able to afford it. One day, he finds an old discarded pilot's hat, and discovers a calling: a group of children in his poor neighborhood assume he's an airline captain and beg him to share stories of the world outside of Amman, Jordan. Through imaginary tales, a friendship forms, and Abu Raed is soon faced with the grim realities of the children's home life. Thus he takes it upon himself to make a difference in their lives.

movies.title: Yomeddine

details.country: Austria, Egypt, United States of America

movies.description: A Coptic leper and his orphaned apprentice leave the confines of the leper colony for the first time and embark on a journey across Egypt to search for what is left of their families.

movies.title: Wajib

details.country: Germany, Colombia, United Arab Emirates, France, Norway, Qatar, Palestinian Territory

movies.description: After years abroad in Italy, Shadi returns to his native Nazareth. But this is no spectacular homecoming. He's back somewhat begrudgingly to honour his "wajib" (or duty) to hand out invitations to his sister's wedding with his father.  The simmering tension between the two — who are often stuck in a car, more often than not in traffic — builds, exposing the sometimes-comic chasms that exist between men who live in different worlds but share an unshakable bond.

movies.title: Where Do We Go Now?

details.writers: Sam Mounier, Rodney Al Haddid, Nadine Labaki, Jihad Hojeily

movies.description: In a remote, isolated Lebanese village surrounded by land mines, Muslims and Christians live together in peace. As civil strife starts to engulf the country around them, the women in the village try, by various means and to varying success, to keep their men in the dark by sabotaging the village radio, and then destroying the village TV.

movies.title: Inshallah a Boy

details.tagline: Nawal’s brave deception.
details.writers: Delphine Agut, Rula Nasser, Amjad Al-Rasheed

movies.description: After the sudden death of her husband, working mother Nawal has to fight for her inheritance in order to save her daughter and home in a society where having a son would be a game changer.

movies.title: Paradise Now

details.tagline: From the most unexpected place, come a new call for peace
details.writers: Bero Beyer, Pierre Hodgson, Hany Abu-Assad

movies.description: Two childhood friends are recruited for a suicide bombing in Tel Aviv

movies.title: Terms of Endearment

details.tagline: Come to laugh, come to cry, come to care, come to terms.

movies.description: Aurora, a finicky woman, is in search of true love while her daughter faces marital issues. Together, they help each other deal with problems and find reasons to live a joyful life.

movies.title: Burning

details.tagline: The truth is all in your head.
details.writers: Lee Chang-dong, Oh Jung-mi, Haruki Murakami

movies.description: Deliveryman Jong-su is out on a job when he runs into Hae-mi, a girl who once lived in his neighborhood. She asks if he'd mind looking after her cat while she's away on a trip to Africa. On her return, she introduces to Jong-su an enigmatic young man named Ben, who she met during her trip. One day Ben tells Jong-su about his most unusual hobby.

movies.title: The Land Before Time

details.tagline: It is the dawn of time, the land of the dinosaur. Lost and alone, Littlefoot and his friends are about to embark on the journey of a lifetime.
details.writers: Tony Geiss, Judy Freudberg, Stu Krieger

movies.description: An orphaned brontosaurus named Littlefoot sets off in search of the legendary Great Valley. A land of lush vegetation where the dinosaurs can thrive and live in peace. Along the way he meets four other young dinosaurs, each one a different species, and they encounter several obstacles as they learn to work together in order to survive.

movies.title: TÁR

details.tagline: An examination of power, its impact, and durability in our modern world.
details.language: Tagalog, German, French, Tamil, English, Portuguese

movies.description: As celebrated conductor Lydia Tár starts rehearsals for a career-defining symphony, the consequences of her past choices begin to echo in the present.

movies.title: Judas and the Black Messiah

details.tagline: You can kill a revolutionary but you can't kill the revolution.
details.writers: Shaka King, Will Berson, Keith Lucas, Kenneth Lucas

movies.description: Bill O'Neal infiltrates the Black Panthers on the orders of FBI Agent Mitchell and J. Edgar Hoover. As Black Panther Chairman Fred Hampton ascends—falling for a fellow revolutionary en route—a battle wages for O’Neal’s soul.

movies.title: Costa Brava, Lebanon

details.country: Denmark, France, Lebanon, Norway, Spain, Sweden, United States of America

movies.description: Members of a family quit the polluted, rubbish-strewn city of Beirut for an idyllic mountain home. However, their dreams of a utopian existence are shattered by the construction of a landfill on the boundary of their land.

movies.title: The Father
movies.description: Vasil has just lost his long-time partner in life, his wife Ivanka. When a woman at her funeral proclaims that the dead woman called her cellphone, Vasil seeks out the help of a well-known psychic in order to try to contact his wife. His son Pavel tries to bring him to his senses, but Vasil stubbornly insists on doing things his own way… Following the internationally successful The Lesson and Glory, Grozeva and Valchanov return with an intimate family drama about the difficulties of connecting with those close to us. As the picture slowly gathers momentum, its story unfolds many of the carefully arranged absurd or comic situations typical for the Bulgarian filmmaking duo.

movies.title: Tootsie

details.tagline: What do you get when you cross a hopelessly straight starving actor with a dynamite red sequined dress? You get America's hottest new actress.
details.writers: Larry Gelbart, Murray Schisgal, Don McGuire, Elaine May

movies.description: When struggling, out of work actor Michael Dorsey secretly adopts a female alter ego—Dorothy Michaels—in order to land a part in a daytime drama, he unwittingly becomes a feminist icon and ends up in a romantic pickle.

movies.title: Minari

details.tagline: A timeless story of what roots us.
details.writers: Lee Isaac Chung, Stefanie Y. Hong

movies.description: A Korean American family moves to an Arkansas farm in search of its own American dream. Amidst the challenges of this new life in the strange and rugged Ozarks, they discover the undeniable resilience of family and what really makes a home.

movies.title: Animal House

details.tagline: It was the Deltas against the rules... the rules lost!
details.writers: Harold Ramis, Chris Miller, Douglas Kenney

movies.description: At a 1962 College, Dean Vernon Wormer is determined to expel the entire Delta Tau Chi Fraternity, but those troublemakers have other plans for him.

movies.title: KPop Demon Hunters

details.tagline: They sing. They dance. They battle demons.
details.writers: Maggie Kang, Danya Jimenez, Hannah McMechan, Chris Appelhans

castDetails.name: Joel Kim Booster
castDetails.character: Variety Show Host 1 / Idol Host / Romance Saja (voice)

castDetails.name: Alan Lee
castDetails.character: Pilot Demon / Variety Show Host 2 / Mystery Saja (voice)

movies.description: When K-pop superstars Rumi, Mira and Zoey aren't selling out stadiums, they're using their secret powers to protect their fans from supernatural threats.

movies.title: Phantom Thread

details.tagline: Whatever you do, do it carefully.

movies.description: In 1950s London, a renowned dressmaker's meticulous lifestyle begins drastically changing as his relationship with his young muse intensifies.

movies.title: The Orphanage

details.tagline: A tale of love. A story of horror.

movies.description: A woman brings her family back to her childhood home, which used to be an orphanage, intent on reopening it. Before long, her son starts to communicate with a new invisible friend.

movies.title: Inside Llewyn Davis

details.tagline: At a crossroads in the music world, where success remains elusive.
details.country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: In Greenwich Village in the early 1960s, gifted but volatile folk musician Llewyn Davis struggles with money, relationships, and his uncertain future.

movies.title: Pinocchio

details.tagline: When you wish upon a star, your dreams come true.
details.writers: Otto Englander, Erdman Penner, Carlo Collodi, William Cottrell

movies.description: When the gentle woodcarver Geppetto builds a marionette to be his substitute son, a benevolent fairy brings the toy to life. The puppet, named Pinocchio, is not yet a human boy. He must earn the right to be real by proving that he is brave, truthful, and unselfish.

movies.title: How to Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World

details.tagline: Fly on your own. Find your way home.

collection.name: How to Train Your Dragon Collection

details.writers: Cressida Cowell, Chris Palmer, Dean DeBlois

movies.description: As Hiccup fulfills his dream of creating a peaceful dragon utopia, Toothless’ discovery of an untamed, elusive mate draws the Night Fury away. When danger mounts at home and Hiccup’s reign as village chief is tested, both dragon and rider must make impossible decisions to save their kind.

movies.title: Galaxy Quest

details.tagline: A comedy of galactic proportions.

movies.description: For four years, the courageous crew of the NSEA Protector —  Commander Peter Quincy Taggart, Lieutenant Tawny Madison, and Doctor Lazarus — set off on a thrilling and often dangerous mission in space... until their series was cancelled! Now, twenty years later, aliens under attack have mistaken the Galaxy Quest television transmissions for "historical documents" and beam up the crew of has-been actors to save the universe. With no script, no director, and no clue, the actors must turn in the performances of their lives.

movies.title: The English Patient

details.tagline: In love, there are no boundaries.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: In the 1930s, Count Almásy is a Hungarian map maker employed by the Royal Geographical Society to chart the vast expanses of the Sahara Desert along with several other prominent explorers. As World War II unfolds, Almásy enters into a world of love, betrayal, and politics.

movies.title: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre

details.tagline: Who will survive and what will be left of them?

movies.description: Five friends head out to rural Texas to visit the grave of a grandfather. On the way, they stumble across what appears to be a deserted house, only to discover something sinister within. Something armed with a chainsaw.

movies.title: Palm Springs

details.tagline: Live like there's no tomorrow

movies.description: When carefree Nyles and reluctant maid of honor Sarah have a chance encounter at a Palm Springs wedding, things get complicated when they find themselves unable to escape the venue, themselves, or each other.

movies.title: [REC]

details.tagline: Experience fear.
details.writers: Jaume Balagueró, Paco Plaza, Luiso Berdejo

movies.description: A television reporter and cameraman follow emergency workers into a dark apartment building and are quickly locked inside with something terrifying.

movies.title: Luca

details.tagline: Prepare for an unforgettable trip.
details.writers: Enrico Casarosa, Jesse Andrews, Simon Stephenson, Randall Green

movies.description: Luca and his best friend Alberto experience an unforgettable summer on the Italian Riviera. But all the fun is threatened by a deeply-held secret: they are sea monsters from another world just below the water’s surface.

movies.title: Carrie

details.tagline: If you've got a taste for terror...Take Carrie to the prom!

movies.description: Withdrawn and sensitive teenager Carrie White faces bullying from her classmates and abuse from her fanatically pious mother. When she begins to suspect that she has supernatural powers, things take a dark and violent turn.

movies.title: Lilo & Stitch

details.tagline: There's one in every family.
details.writers: John Sanford, Roger Allers, Ed Gombert, Chris Sanders

movies.description: As Stitch, a runaway genetic experiment from a faraway planet, wreaks havoc on the Hawaiian Islands, he becomes the mischievous adopted alien "puppy" of an independent little girl named Lilo and learns about loyalty, friendship, and ʻohana, the Hawaiian tradition of family.

movies.title: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang

details.tagline: Sex. Murder. Mystery. Welcome to the party.

movies.description: A petty thief posing as an actor is brought to Los Angeles for an unlikely audition and finds himself in the middle of a murder investigation along with his high school dream girl and a detective who's been training him for his upcoming role...

movies.title: The Emperor's New Groove

details.tagline: It's all about... ME!
details.writers: David Reynolds, Matthew Jacobs, Mark Kennedy, John Norton

movies.description: When the self‑absorbed Emperor Kuzco is accidentally transformed into a llama, he must rely on a humble villager to survive the jungle and reclaim his throne.

movies.title: Bram Stoker's Dracula

details.tagline: Love never dies.

movies.description: Count Dracula, a 15th-century prince, is condemned to live off the blood of the living for eternity. Young lawyer Jonathan Harker is sent to Dracula's castle to finalise a land deal, but when the Count sees a photo of Harker's fiancée, Mina, the spitting image of his dead wife, he imprisons him and sets off for London to track her down.

movies.title: The Karate Kid

details.tagline: He taught him the secret to karate lies in the mind and heart. Not in the hands.
details.writers: Robert Mark Kamen, Allee Willis, Dennis Lambert, Peter Beckett

movies.description: New Jersey teen Daniel LaRusso moves to Los Angeles with his mother, and soon strikes up a relationship with Ali. He quickly finds himself the target of bullying by a group of thugs, led by Ali's ex-boyfriend Johnny, who study karate at the Cobra Kai dojo under ruthless sensei John Kreese. Fortunately, Daniel befriends Mr. Miyagi, an unassuming repairman who just happens to be a martial arts master himself. Miyagi takes Daniel under his wing, training him in a more compassionate form of karate for self-defense and, later, preparing him to compete against the brutal Cobra Kai.

movies.title: Conclave

details.tagline: What happens behind these walls will change everything.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

movies.description: After the unexpected death of the Pope, Cardinal Lawrence is tasked with managing the covert and ancient ritual of electing a new one. Sequestered in the Vatican with the Catholic Church’s most powerful leaders until the process is complete, Lawrence finds himself at the center of a conspiracy that could lead to its downfall.

movies.title: Anora

details.tagline: Love is a hustle.

movies.description: A young sex worker from Brooklyn gets her chance at a Cinderella story when she meets and impulsively marries the son of an oligarch. Once the news reaches Russia, her fairytale is threatened as his parents set out to get the marriage annulled.

movies.title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga

details.tagline: Fury is born.

movies.description: As the world falls, young Furiosa is snatched from the Green Place of Many Mothers into the hands of a great biker horde led by the warlord Dementus. Sweeping through the wasteland, they encounter the citadel presided over by Immortan Joe. The two tyrants wage war for dominance, and Furiosa must survive many trials as she puts together the means to find her way home.

movies.title: War for the Planet of the Apes

details.tagline: For freedom. For family. For the planet.
details.writers: Mark Bomback, Matt Reeves, Rick Jaffa, Amanda Silver

movies.description: Caesar and his apes are forced into a deadly conflict with an army of humans led by a ruthless Colonel. After the apes suffer unimaginable losses, Caesar wrestles with his darker instincts and begins his own mythic quest to avenge his kind. As the journey finally brings them face to face, Caesar and the Colonel are pitted against each other in an epic battle that will determine the fate of both their species and the future of the planet.

movies.title: Babel

details.tagline: If you want to be understood... listen.
details.language: Arabic, English, Spanish, French, Japanese, Russian
details.country: France, Mexico, United States of America

movies.description: Tragedy strikes a married couple vacationing in the Moroccan desert, which jumpstarts an interlocking story involving four different families.

movies.title: Corpse Bride

details.tagline: There's been a grave misunderstanding.
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
details.writers: Pamela Pettler, John August, Caroline Thompson, Brendan Houghton

castDetails.name: Paul Whitehouse
castDetails.character: William Van Dort / Mayhew / Paul the Head Waiter (voice)

movies.description: In a 19th-century European village, a young man about to be married is whisked away to the underworld and wed to a mysterious corpse bride, while his real bride waits bereft in the land of the living.

movies.title: Predestination

details.tagline: To save the future he must reshape the past.
details.writers: Michael Spierig, Peter Spierig, Robert A. Heinlein

movies.description: Predestination chronicles the life of a Temporal Agent sent on an intricate series of time-travel journeys designed to prevent future killers from committing their crimes. Now, on his final assignment, the Agent must stop the one criminal that has eluded him throughout time and prevent a devastating attack in which thousands of lives will be lost.

movies.title: Me Before You

details.tagline: Live boldly.
details.writers: Jojo Moyes, Michael H. Weber, Scott Neustadter

movies.description: Lou Clark, a directionless 26-year-old from the English countryside, takes a job at the local castle as a caregiver and companion to a wealthy young banker, Will Traynor. Wheelchair-bound from an accident two years prior, the once adventurous Will has all but given up — that is until Lou determines to show him that life is worth living.

movies.title: Zero Dark Thirty

details.tagline: The greatest manhunt in history.

movies.description: A chronicle of the decade-long hunt for al-Qaeda terrorist leader Osama bin Laden after the September 2001 attacks, and his death at the hands of the Navy S.E.A.L. Team 6 in May, 2011.

movies.title: Moonlight

details.tagline: This is the story of a lifetime

movies.description: The tender, heartbreaking story of a young man’s struggle to find himself, told across three defining chapters in his life as he experiences the ecstasy, pain, and beauty of falling in love, while grappling with his own sexuality.

movies.title: Uncut Gems

details.tagline: This is how I win.
details.writers: Josh Safdie, Ronald Bronstein, Benny Safdie

movies.description: A charismatic New York City jeweler always on the lookout for the next big score makes a series of high-stakes bets that could lead to the windfall of a lifetime. Howard must perform a precarious high-wire act, balancing business, family, and encroaching adversaries on all sides in his relentless pursuit of the ultimate win.

movies.title: Up in the Air

details.tagline: The story of a man ready to make a connection.
details.writers: Jason Reitman, Sheldon Turner, Walter Kirn

movies.description: Corporate downsizing expert Ryan Bingham spends his life in planes, airports, and hotels, but just as he’s about to reach a milestone of ten million frequent flyer miles, he meets a woman who causes him to rethink his transient life.

movies.title: Lady Bird

details.tagline: Fly away home.

movies.description: Lady Bird McPherson, a strong willed, deeply opinionated, artistic 17 year old comes of age in Sacramento. Her relationship with her mother and her upbringing are questioned and tested as she plans to head off to college.

movies.title: Nobody

details.tagline: Never underestimate a nobody.

movies.description: Hutch Mansell, a suburban dad, overlooked husband, nothing neighbor — a "nobody." When two thieves break into his home one night, Hutch's unknown long-simmering rage is ignited and propels him on a brutal path that will uncover dark secrets he fought to leave behind.

movies.title: Weapons

details.tagline: Last night at 2:17 AM, every child from Mrs. Gandy's class woke up, got out of bed, went downstairs, opened the front door, walked into the dark ...and they never came back.

movies.description: When all but one child from the same class mysteriously vanish on the same night at exactly the same time, a community is left questioning who or what is behind their disappearance.

movies.title: Beetlejuice

details.tagline: In this house... if you've seen one ghost... you haven't seen them all.
details.writers: Warren Skaaren, Michael McDowell, Larry Wilson

movies.description: A newly dead New England couple seeks help from a deranged demon exorcist to scare an affluent New York family out of their home.

movies.title: The Nice Guys

details.tagline: They're not that nice.

movies.description: A private eye investigates the apparent suicide of a fading porn star in 1970s Los Angeles and uncovers a conspiracy.

movies.title: Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation

details.tagline: Desperate times. Desperate measures.
details.writers: Bruce Geller, Drew Pearce, Christopher McQuarrie

movies.description: Ethan and team take on their most impossible mission yet—eradicating 'The Syndicate', an International and highly-skilled rogue organization committed to destroying the IMF.

movies.title: Borat: Cultural Learnings of America for Make Benefit Glorious Nation of Kazakhstan

details.tagline: Come to Kazakhstan, it's nice!
details.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
details.writers: Sacha Baron Cohen, Dan Mazer, Anthony Hines, Peter Baynham

movies.description: Kazakh journalist Borat Sagdiyev travels to America to make a documentary. As he zigzags across the nation, Borat meets real people in real situations with hysterical consequences. His backwards behavior generates strong reactions around him exposing prejudices and hypocrisies in American culture.

movies.title: John Wick: Chapter 3 - Parabellum

details.tagline: If you want peace, prepare for war.
details.language: Arabic, Mandarin, English, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Latin, Russian
details.writers: Derek Kolstad, Chris Collins, Marc Abrams, Shay Hatten

movies.description: Super-assassin John Wick returns with a $14 million price tag on his head and an army of bounty-hunting killers on his trail. After killing a member of the shadowy international assassin’s guild, the High Table, John Wick is excommunicado, but the world’s most ruthless hit men and women await his every turn.

movies.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows

details.tagline: The game is afoot.
details.writers: Arthur Conan Doyle, Kieran Mulroney, Michele Mulroney

movies.description: There is a new criminal mastermind at large (Professor Moriarty) and not only is he Holmes’ intellectual equal, but his capacity for evil and lack of conscience may give him an advantage over the detective.

movies.title: Ready Player One

details.tagline: A better reality awaits.

movies.description: When the creator of a popular video game system dies, a virtual contest is created to compete for his fortune.

movies.title: Shrek 2

details.tagline: What happens after happily ever after?
details.writers: Andrew Adamson, J. David Stem, Joe Stillman, David N. Weiss

movies.description: Happily ever after never seemed so far far away when a trip to meet the in-laws turns into a hilariously twisted adventure for Shrek and Fiona. With the help of ever-faithful Donkey, Shrek takes on the potion-brewing Fairy Godmother, pompous Prince Charming, and infamous ogre-killer Puss In Boots.

movies.title: Mission: Impossible - Ghost Protocol

details.tagline: No plan. No backup. No choice.
details.writers: Bruce Geller, André Nemec, Josh Appelbaum

movies.description: Ethan Hunt and his team are racing against time to track down a dangerous terrorist named Hendricks, who has gained access to Russian nuclear launch codes and is planning a strike on the United States. An attempt to stop him ends in an explosion causing severe destruction to the Kremlin and the IMF to be implicated in the bombing, forcing the President to disavow them. No longer being aided by the government, Ethan and his team chase Hendricks around the globe, although they might still be too late to stop a disaster.

movies.title: John Wick: Chapter 2

details.tagline: Never stab the devil in the back!
